aBCOrD.name: A, B, C, or D
aBCOrD.description: 10% chance to raise Attack by 1 stage. 10% chance to burn the target. 10% chance to confuse the target. 10% chance to make the target drowsy.

aCounterInfector.name: A-Counter Infector
aCounterInfector.description: When hit by a physical attack, the user has a 30% chance to inflict a random status condition on the attacker. If the attacker is statused, when contact occurs the attacker's highest stat drops by one stage and the user restores 10% of its max HP.

aParasiticOffspring.name: A-Parasitic Offspring
aParasiticOffspring.description: The user's physical attacks have a 30% chance to inflict a random status condition on the target. If the target is statused, contact moves against the user have a 30% chance to seed the attacker with Leech Seed and a 30% chance to confuse them.

aSuppression.name: A-Suppression
aSuppression.description: Opposing Pokémon with status conditions take 30% more damage from attacks and cannot use their abilities.

aWinner.name: A Winner
aWinner.description: Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

abandoned.name: Abandoned
abandoned.description: Raises Attack and Speed by 1 stage after being hit by an attack.

abilityTextHere.name: Ability Text Here
abilityTextHere.description: Gives the opponent this ability when entering battle. Raises two random stats by 1 stage when entering battle.

abominableProtection.name: Abominable Protection
abominableProtection.description: When the user switches in, it sets up Aurora Veil without needing Hail or Snow, but loses 25% of its max HP. This effect can only occur once per battle.

absoluteLightning.name: Absolute Lightning
absoluteLightning.description: The first damaging hit taken each battle is negated, and the attacker takes 1/8 of their max HP instead. Normal-type moves become Electric-type and deal 1.2× damage.

absoluteVoidMagic.name: Absolute Void Magic
absoluteVoidMagic.description: The user's attacks have a 50% chance to inflict a random status condition, temporary status condition, trap, or hazard. The user takes damage equal to 1/6 of its max HP at the end of each turn.

absoluteZero.name: Absolute Zero
absoluteZero.description: While Hail or Snow is active, the user's Normal-, Flying-, and Dragon-type moves become Ice-type, deal 1.2× damage, and have a 10% chance to freeze the target. Frozen targets cannot switch out and take damage equal to 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.

abyssalAqua.name: Abyssal Aqua
abyssalAqua.description: Water, Ghost, and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 30% chance to trap the target in a whirlpool.

abyssalFlame.name: Abyssal Flame
abyssalFlame.description: Normal moves change to Fire type. Fire-type and Dark-type share type weakness advantages and have 30% chance to burn.

abyssalGrasp.name: Abyssal Grasp
abyssalGrasp.description: Normal-type moves become Water-type. Water-type moves have a 30% chance to inflict Whirlpool on the target.

abyssalLure.name: Abyssal Lure
abyssalLure.description: 50% chance to halve damage from super effective moves. 50% chance to deal damage equal to 1/4 of the attacker's max HP when hit by a super effective move. 50% chance to restore 1/6 of max HP when hit by a super effective move.

abyssalMelody.name: Abyssal Melody
abyssalMelody.description: Changes all moves to sound-based and boosts their power by 20%. Boosts sound-based moves by 50%. 10% chance to curse the target.

abyssalStance.name: Abyssal Stance
abyssalStance.description: 30% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after being hit by an attack. 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP after being hit by an attack. 10% chance to lower a random stat of the user by 1 stage after attacking. Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%.

acidRain.name: Acid Rain
acidRain.description: When the user enters battle, it sets Rain. Poison-type moves deal 1.3× damage while Rain is active. Normal-type moves become Water-type. While Rain is active, they become Poison-type.

acidWater.name: Acid Water
acidWater.description: Poison and Water-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Poison-type and boosts their power by 20%. Doubles power against Normal, Steel, and Fighting-type Pokemon when using Water or Poison-type moves.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.description: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

adaptabugility.name: Adaptabugility
adaptabugility.description: Triples the power of Bug-type moves.

adaptiveAi.name: Adaptive AI
adaptiveAi.description: Raises stats by 1 or 2 stages depending on the opponent's highest stat. Raises Defense if opponent's highest stat is Attack, Special Defense if opponent's highest stat is Special Attack, Special Attack if opponent's highest stat is Special Defense, or Speed by 2 stages if opponent's highest stat is Speed.

adventureStart.name: Adventure Start!
adventureStart.description: The user's moves have a 50% chance to gain priority. All of the user's moves gain +1 critical hit stage.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.description: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.

alienCat.name: Alien Cat
alienCat.description: Boosts Psychic-type moves by 20%. Infatuates cat-like Pokemon of the opposite gender. Immune to Ground-type moves.

alienRock.name: Alien Rock
alienRock.description: Psychic and Rock-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

alienType.name: Alien Type
alienType.description: Boosts Ice, Electric, and Grass-type moves by 20%.

allConsuming.name: All Consuming
allConsuming.description: Restores 1/8 of max HP and deals 1/8 of max HP as damage to the opponent when hit by a contact move.

almightyGalaxy.name: Almighty Galaxy
almightyGalaxy.description: At the end of each turn, the user changes to a random type and restores 1/8 of its max HP. Attacks without secondary effects have a 30% chance to inflict a random status condition.

alternativeBurst.name: Alternative Burst
alternativeBurst.description: The user's status moves inflict damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP. Electric- and Dragon-type moves have a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.description: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

ancientAutomaton.name: Ancient Automaton
ancientAutomaton.description: Raises a random stat among Speed, Defense, and Attack by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

ancientBehemoth.name: Ancient Behemoth
ancientBehemoth.description: The user's contact moves ignore type resistances and deal 1.3× damage.

ancientDisguise.name: Ancient Disguise
ancientDisguise.description: The Pokemon is protected from damage when it enters a battle or when its HP is full. This protection is removed after the Pokemon takes damage. Rock-type moves charge this ability.

ancientDrill.name: Ancient Drill
ancientDrill.description: The user's attacks have a 50% chance to remove the target's held item and deal additional damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

ancientDualCore.name: Ancient Dual Core
ancientDualCore.description: On turn 1, the user is Normal-type. On turn 2, it becomes Steel- and Fighting-type. Normal-type moves become Steel-type, are also treated as Fighting-type, and deal 1.2× damage.

ancientKnowledge.name: Ancient Knowledge
ancientKnowledge.description: The user's Psychic- and Fairy-type moves deal 1.2× damage and share the same type weakness advantages.

ancientSummon.name: Ancient Summon
ancientSummon.description: On switch-in, the user gains +1 stage to a random stat for each other party Pokémon that has a Gadget move. Each stat increase is randomly chosen.

ancientSupplies.name: Ancient Supplies
ancientSupplies.description: When the user is switched out, the incoming Pokémon heals 25% of its max HP and gains +1 Defense.

angerPoint.name: Anger Point
angerPoint.description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

angerShell.name: Anger Shell
angerShell.description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

animified.name: Animified
animified.description: Resists Normal and Fighting-type moves. Weak to Poison-type moves. Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and are boosted by 20%. 30% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

antRegen.name: Ant Regen
antRegen.description: Restores HP at the end of each turn.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.description: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

apexPredator.name: Apex Predator
apexPredator.description: Lowers Defense by 1 stage when entering battle. Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

aquaDisguise.name: Aqua Disguise
aquaDisguise.description: The Pokemon is protected from damage when it enters a battle or when its HP is full. This protection is removed after the Pokemon takes damage. Water-type moves charge this ability.

aquaticRitual.name: Aquatic Ritual
aquaticRitual.description: If Rain is active, the user raises two random stats at the end of each turn.

arcticBlaze.name: Arctic Blaze
arcticBlaze.description: Changes Ice-type moves to Fire-type and vice versa, boosting their power by 35% when HP is below 65%.

armorTail.name: Armor Tail
armorTail.description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

aromaVeil.name: Aroma Veil
aromaVeil.description: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.

asOneGlastrier.name: As One
asOneGlastrier.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

asOneSpectrier.name: As One
asOneSpectrier.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.

attackBoost.name: Attack Boost
attackBoost.description: Raises Attack by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

auraBreak.name: Aura Break
auraBreak.description: The effects of "Aura" Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.

axe.name: Axe
axe.description: Boosts the power of slicing moves by 50%. Boosts Steel-type moves by 30%.

badDreams.name: Bad Dreams
badDreams.description: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Immune to confusion. Moves used by this Pokemon cannot miss. 50% chance to halve damage from attacks.

balancedKick.name: Balanced Kick
balancedKick.description: Kicking moves never miss and have their power boosted by 20%.

ballFetch.name: Ball Fetch
ballFetch.description: The Pokémon will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

battleArmor.name: Battle Armor
battleArmor.description: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

battleBond.name: Battle Bond
battleBond.description: Defeating an opposing Pokémon strengthens the Pokémon's bond with its Trainer, and it becomes Ash-Greninja. Water Shuriken gets more powerful.

beadsOfRuin.name: Beads of Ruin
beadsOfRuin.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

beastBoost.name: Beast Boost
beastBoost.description: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

beastMode.name: Beast Mode
beastMode.description: Doubles move power when HP is below 40%.

beastOfRagnarok.name: Beast of Ragnarok
beastOfRagnarok.description: In snow or hail, the user's Speed is doubled, and biting moves have a 10% chance to freeze the target or a 10% chance to flinch the target.

beaststar.name: Beaststar
beaststar.description: The user's attacks deal 1.5× damage. If an attack cannot cause flinching, it has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. The user's Defense and Special Defense drop by one stage after attacking.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

bigGuts.name: Big Guts
bigGuts.description: Attack is doubled when the Pokemon has a status condition. Ignores Attack drop from burn.

bigPecks.name: Big Pecks
bigPecks.description: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.

blackAndRed.name: Black and Red
blackAndRed.description: Dark and Fire-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 15% chance to burn the target. Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%.

blackAndWhite.name: Black and White
blackAndWhite.description: Negates damage from moves that are not Normal or Dark-type.

blackFlameSpark.name: Black Flame Spark
blackFlameSpark.description: After the user is hit by an attack, it gains a charge. If the user switches out while charged, the target is burned and the Pokémon switched in gains +1 Speed and +1 random stat.

blandCardboardEater.name: Bland Cardboard Eater
blandCardboardEater.description: Triples move power against SmittyXTV. Raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move. Restores 1/8 of max HP when using a Grass-type move.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

blazingCitrine.name: Blazing Citrine
blazingCitrine.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Fire-type or Rock-type depending on which type would deal more damage to the target. If neutral, the type is chosen at random. Fire-type and Rock-type moves have a 30% chance to burn the target. Burned targets cannot use their abilities and have their moves' secondary effects disabled.

blazingTimber.name: Blazing Timber
blazingTimber.description: The user's Normal-type and Grass-type moves become Fire-type, have a 30% chance to burn the target, and deal 1.3× damage.

blindRage.name: Blind Rage
blindRage.description: While confused, the user's moves deal 2× damage and have +1 critical hit stage. Normal-type moves share Fighting-type moves' type matchup advantages.

bloodScent.name: Blood Scent
bloodScent.description: The user's attacks automatically land as critical hits against targets below 40% HP.

blowbackRoulette.name: Blowback Roulette
blowbackRoulette.description: The user's Dark- and Steel-type moves have a 30% chance to randomly lower three of the target's stats by one stage each.

boosheFurCoat.name: Booshe Fur Coat
boosheFurCoat.description: Halves damage from Physical moves. 40% chance to reduce damage from Special moves by 25%.

boredomAura.name: Boredom Aura
boredomAura.description: Lowers a random stat of the opponent by 2 stages at the end of each turn.

boring.name: Boring
boring.description: Lowers a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle and at the end of each turn. Boosts Normal-type moves by 30%.

bounceBack.name: Bounce Back
bounceBack.description: 30% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out and deal 1/8 of the attacker's max HP as damage.

boxBorn.name: Box Born
boxBorn.description: Reduces the power of ball, sphere, and orb-related moves by 75%. Boosts Steel-type moves by 20%.

bubblingBrains.name: Bubbling Brains
bubblingBrains.description: Boosts Water-type moves by 50%. Restores 1/8 of max HP when using a contact move.

bugabugabuga.name: Bugabugabuga
bugabugabuga.description: Lowers all stats by 1 stage when entering battle. Prevents the opponent from switching out. Takes 20% more damage from attacks.

bullRush.name: Bull Rush
bullRush.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Fighting-type and gain +1 priority.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.description: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

burningDisease.name: Burning Disease
burningDisease.description: Deals 1/8 of the attacker's max HP as damage if they are burned. 30% chance to burn the target.

cardboardEmpire.name: Cardboard Empire
cardboardEmpire.description: Raises two random stats by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent. Restores 1/8 of max HP after knocking out an opponent.

carnivore.name: Carnivore
carnivore.description: Restores 1/8 of max HP when attacking certain types of Pokemon. Raises Attack and Speed by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

carnivorousVines.name: Carnivorous Vines
carnivorousVines.description: The user's contact moves have a 50% chance to trap the target for three turns, dealing damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP each turn.

chainsOfInfinity.name: Chains of Infinity
chainsOfInfinity.description: Moves that deal 60 or less damage have a 1% chance to instantly knock out the target.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Raises all stats by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent. Badly poisons itself after using a move.

chaosEnd.name: Chaos End
chaosEnd.description: If the user's party has a fainted Dark-type Pokémon, after the user knocks out the target, the next Pokémon switched in takes damage equal to 1/6 of its max HP. If the user's party has a fainted Fairy-type Pokémon, the user's Normal-type moves become Dark-type and deal 1.2× damage. If the user's party has fainted Dark-type, Fairy-type, and Dark/Fairy-type Pokémon (three fainted allies in total, not including this Pokémon), when the user faints, the opposing Pokémon takes damage equal to 50% of its max HP.

chaosOrder.name: Chaos Order
chaosOrder.description: The user takes 50% less damage from opponents with 600 or higher total BST. The user's Normal-type moves change to Fairy-type or Dark-type depending on which type would deal more damage. If the types are neutral, one is chosen at random. When the user knocks out the target with a Fairy-type move, it recovers 1/4 of its HP. When the user knocks out the target with a Dark-type move, it gains +1 Attack or Speed at random.

chaosSorcerer.name: Chaos Sorcerer
chaosSorcerer.description: The user has the effects of Moody. The user's special moves have a 30% chance to confuse the target.

chaosWarrior.name: Chaos Warrior
chaosWarrior.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Dark-type or Fairy-type depending on which type would deal more damage to the target. If the types are neutral, one is chosen at random. Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. Fairy-type moves have a 30% chance to lower the target's Attack and Special Attack.

chargeChampion.name: Charge Champion
chargeChampion.description: The user's charging moves deal 50% damage on the first turn and raise two random stats.

charmingMist.name: Charming Mist
charmingMist.description: Ghost and Fairy-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Fairy-type and boosts their power by 20%. 20% chance to infatuate the target when using a Fairy or Ghost-type move if they are the opposite gender.

charredMemory.name: Charred Memory
charredMemory.description: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 1 stage after using a Fire-type move. Fire and Psychic-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Psychic-type and boosts their power by 20%.

cheekPouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheekPouch.description: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

chillingNeigh.name: Chilling Neigh
chillingNeigh.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

clayColossus.name: Clay Colossus
clayColossus.description: The user takes no damage from moves that are not very effective. The user's Normal-type moves change to Ground-type. Ground-type moves have a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed.

clearBody.name: Clear Body
clearBody.description: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

climateChange.name: Climate Change
climateChange.description: During sunny weather, the user's Normal- and Water-type moves become Fire-type and have a 30% chance to burn the target. During rain, the user's Normal- and Fire-type moves become Water-type and have a 10% chance to trap the target in Whirlpool.

cloakOfShadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloakOfShadows.description: Boosts Ghost-type moves by 20%. Changes Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 20%. Reduces damage from super effective moves by 25%.

clubClobber.name: Club Clobber
clubClobber.description: Boosts Rock-type moves by 20%. Boosts the power of contact moves by 40%.

clusterBurst.name: Cluster Burst
clusterBurst.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Water-type. While it is raining or during Heavy Rain, the user's Water-type moves have a 50% chance to hit twice.

cockadoodleYes.name: Cockadoodle Yes
cockadoodleYes.description: Raises a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle. Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent. Boosts the power of contact moves by 30%.

cogOverload.name: Cog Overload
cogOverload.description: Boosts the power of gear and spin-related moves by 50%.

colorChange.name: Color Change
colorChange.description: The Pokémon's type becomes the type of the move used on it.

colorChangeDefense.name: Color Change Defense
colorChangeDefense.description: Changes the user's type to match the type of move it was hit by. If the user isn't already the same type, it also heals 1/8 of its max HP.

colorChangeSteal.name: Color Change Steal
colorChangeSteal.description: Changes the user's type to match the type of move it was hit by. Steals the target's held item if the user shares a type with the target.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.description: It's always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.

commander.name: Commander
commander.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.

compoundEyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundEyes.description: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

conquerorHaki.name: Conqueror Haki
conquerorHaki.description: 20% chance to double move power. 10% chance to put the target to sleep or paralyze it on contact.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Poison-type and deal 1.2× damage. Poison-type moves badly poison the target.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.description: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

copyGuard.name: Copy Guard
copyGuard.description: Moves used by this Pokemon cannot miss. Reduces damage from super effective moves by 25%.

copycatNinja.name: Copycat Ninja
copycatNinja.description: Changes the user's type to match the type of move it was hit by. If the user isn't already the same type, it also heals 1/8 of its max HP.

cornfieldGuardian.name: Cornfield Guardian
cornfieldGuardian.description: While Grassy Terrain is active, the user gains +1 Attack and cures its status condition at the end of each turn.

corpseParty.name: Corpse Party
corpseParty.description: The user's Ghost-type moves gain 5 base power for each Ghost-type Pokémon in the party. Normal-type moves become Ghost-type.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.description: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.

corrupt.name: Corrupt
corrupt.description: Has a 70% chance to badly poison the target after attacking.

corruptElephant.name: Corrupt Elephant
corruptElephant.description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type or Dark-type depending on which type is stronger against the target (chosen at random if neutral). When hit by an attack, the user restores 1/8 of its max HP and raises its Attack by one stage. If the user is holding an item, it randomly loses one held item.

corruptedPower.name: Corrupted Power
corruptedPower.description: Using the same move consecutively boosts its power by 40% each time, but the user takes 33% recoil damage.

corruptionBlaze.name: Corruption Blaze
corruptionBlaze.description: Boosts Fire-type moves when HP is low. Dark and Fire-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 30% chance to disable the target's last used move.

costar.name: Costar
costar.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

cottonDown.name: Cotton Down
cottonDown.description: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

cottonTokens.name: Cotton Tokens
cottonTokens.description: When the user takes an attack that deals 70% or more of its max HP without causing it to faint, it creates a Substitute with 25% of its max HP.

counterCoat.name: Counter Coat
counterCoat.description: Damages the attacker by 1/6 of its max HP when hit by a contact move. Reduces damage taken by 15%.

creepySurprise.name: Creepy Surprise
creepySurprise.description: If this Pokémon has less than 50% HP, it paralyzes the target upon entry. This Pokémon cannot switch out after using this ability.

crimsonGear.name: Crimson Gear
crimsonGear.description: Fire & Steel moves share type weak advantages. Normal moves turn to Fire type and deal 1.2x damage. If at least 2 other party pokemon have a Gadget-move, Electric also share its type weak advantages with Fire and Steel.

cripplingIllusions.name: Crippling Illusions
cripplingIllusions.description: At the end of each turn, the user randomly raises its Defense or Special Defense by one stage. Once the total of both stat stages is 6 or more, both stages reset to 0 and the target is cursed.

criticalPredator.name: Critical Predator
criticalPredator.description: The user's physical moves deal 2.5× damage when the target's Defense stat is greater than or equal to its Attack stat.

crowClone.name: Crow Clone
crowClone.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Flying-type and boosts their power by 20%. Dark, Fire, and Flying-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 30% chance to halve damage from attacks. 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit by an attack.

crystalLuster.name: Crystal Luster
crystalLuster.description: Normal-type and Dragon-type moves become Ice-type or Rock-type depending on which type deals more damage to the target (chosen at random if neutral). Ice-type moves have a 10% chance to freeze the target. Rock-type moves have a 10% chance to inflict Salt Cure on the target.

cudChew.name: Cud Chew
cudChew.description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

curiousMedicine.name: Curious Medicine
curiousMedicine.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

cursedBlades.name: Cursed Blades
cursedBlades.description: Boosts the power of slicing moves by 50%. 20% chance to curse the target.

cursedBody.name: Cursed Body
cursedBody.description: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

cursedFlamesV2.name: Cursed Flames
cursedFlamesV2.description: Normal moves become Fire or Ghost (whichever is stronger against foe - random if neutral). Fire moves have 30% burn chance, Ghost have 5% curse chance.

cursedFlamesYu.name: Cursed Flames
cursedFlamesYu.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Fire-type moves have a 10% chance to inflict Burn on the attacker and trap the attacker in Fire Spin.

cursedPossession.name: Cursed Possession
cursedPossession.description: When the user is hit by a super-effective move, the attacker is cursed.

cursedPotential.name: Cursed Potential
cursedPotential.description: Upon entry, the user raises all of its stats by one stage. At the end of each turn, it randomly either lowers two to three random stats by one stage or loses 1/4 of its max HP. The user cannot switch out.

cursedShell.name: Cursed Shell
cursedShell.description: 10% chance to curse the target. Reduces damage from Physical moves by 25%.

cuteCharm.name: Cute Charm
cuteCharm.description: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

cyberneticControl.name: Cybernetic Control
cyberneticControl.description: Opposing Pokémon cannot use status moves or their abilities.

cyberneticDiscard.name: Cybernetic Discard
cyberneticDiscard.description: The user discards a random held item to increase Attack power by 1.2× and restore 25% of the damage dealt.

cyberneticPredator.name: Cybernetic Predator
cyberneticPredator.description: The user's attacks deal double damage to the target switching in. When the target switches in, the user gains +1 Speed.

cycloneFist.name: Cyclone Fist
cycloneFist.description: When the user enters battle, it triggers Tailwind. Fighting and Flying share type weakness advantages.

cycloneWrath.name: Cyclone Wrath
cycloneWrath.description: When the user switches in, it immediately becomes Wind Charged. If hit by a move while Wind Charged, the user takes 0 damage and the attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP instead. Both effects can only occur once per battle. Normal-type moves become Flying-type and deal 1.2× damage.

cyclonicShift.name: Cyclonic Shift
cyclonicShift.description: Whenever the user attacks, the target's Defense and Attack swap, and the target's Special Attack and Special Defense swap.

damBuilder.name: Dam Builder
damBuilder.description: When the user switches in, it sets a Substitute. Whenever the Substitute breaks, the user gains Aqua Ring.

damp.name: Damp
damp.description: Prevents the use of explosive moves, such as Self-Destruct, by dampening its surroundings.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.description: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.

dangerDiscard.name: Danger! Discard
dangerDiscard.description: The user's status moves randomly raise one of the user's stats and randomly lower one other stat.

darkAura.name: Dark Aura
darkAura.description: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.

darkSeed.name: Dark Seed
darkSeed.description: Grass and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to make the target flinch or seed it when using a Grass or Normal-type move.

darkSide.name: Dark Side
darkSide.description: Doubles the power of Dark-type moves.

darkSoundwave.name: Dark Soundwave
darkSoundwave.description: Normal-type and Dark-type moves become Sound moves, and Sound moves become Dark-type moves, deal 1.1x damage, and have a 10% chance to randomly put the target to sleep, confuse the target, or make the target flinch.

darkStampede.name: Dark Stampede
darkStampede.description: Raises a random stat by 1 stage after using a Dark-type move.

darkWaters.name: Dark Waters
darkWaters.description: Dark and Water-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to trap the target in a whirlpool when using a Water or Dark-type move. 10% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP when using a Water or Dark-type move.

darkworldTactics.name: Darkworld Tactics
darkworldTactics.description: At the end of the turn, if the user has any negative stat stages, the user resets them, heals 1/6 of its max HP, and increases a random stat by one stage.

dauntlessShield.name: Dauntless Shield
dauntlessShield.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.description: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

deadlyBrine.name: Deadly Brine
deadlyBrine.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Water-type. Boosts Water-type moves by 30%. Water and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 10% chance to badly poison the target.

deathClaws.name: Death Claws
deathClaws.description: Boosts the power of contact moves by 50%. Moves that would be not very effective become neutral.

debilitatingRocket.name: Debilitating Rocket
debilitatingRocket.description: Normal moves turn into Steel or Flying, depending on which does more (random if neutral). Steel / Flying have 30% chance to lower foe's atk by 2 stages.

deepRoots.name: Deep Roots
deepRoots.description: At the end of each turn, the user restores 1/16 of its max HP and swaps its Special Attack and Special Defense stats.

deepSeaVirus.name: Deep Sea Virus
deepSeaVirus.description: Deals 1/8 of the attacker's max HP as damage if they are badly poisoned. 30% chance to badly poison the target.

deepThoughts.name: Deep Thoughts
deepThoughts.description: 30% chance to confuse the target after using a move.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.description: Halves the Pokémon's Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.

deflectionHide.name: Deflection Hide
deflectionHide.description: The user takes 30% less damage from moves. When hit by a contact move, it deals damage equal to 1/16 of the attacker's max HP back to them.

deltaStream.name: Delta Stream
deltaStream.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type's weaknesses.

demonSwordsman.name: Demon Swordsman
demonSwordsman.description: Boosts the power of slicing moves by 50%. Steel, Ghost, and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

demonicEdge.name: Demonic Edge
demonicEdge.description: Normal-type moves become Steel-type and deal 1.2× damage. Critical hits deal 2.5× damage.

desolateLand.name: Desolate Land
desolateLand.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.

despair.name: Despair
despair.description: Lowers a random stat of the opponent by 1 stage and raises a random stat of the user by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

dimensionSlash.name: Dimension Slash
dimensionSlash.description: Slashing moves deal 1.2× damage, become Dark-type moves, and have a 10% chance to force the target to switch.

dirtThick.name: Dirt Thick
dirtThick.description: Halves damage from Water and Ground-type moves.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

dittoType.name: Ditto Type
dittoType.description: Changes the user's type to resist the type of move it was hit by. Restores 1/8 of max HP if the type changes.

dnaChange.name: DNA Change
dnaChange.description: 50% chance to change type and restore 1/8 of max HP when using a move.

doomGadgets.name: Doom Gadgets
doomGadgets.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Steel-type and boosts their power by 20%. Boosts Steel-type moves by 20%. 10% chance to paralyze, burn, poison, or badly poison the target.

download.name: Download
download.description: Compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

dracoForm.name: Draco Form
dracoForm.description: Boosts Dragon-type moves by 20%. Dragon and Normal-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

dracoLance.name: Draco Lance
dracoLance.description: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type. Dragon-type moves deal 1.5× damage if the target's Defense stat is greater than its Attack stat.

dracoNegation.name: Draco Negation
dracoNegation.description: 30% chance to negate status moves foe. When a status move is negated, damage foe 1/16 and raise user random stat.

draconicFlute.name: Draconic Flute
draconicFlute.description: The user's Normal-type and Dragon-type moves turn into Sound-type moves and deal 1.2x damage. Sound-type moves have a 10% chance to put the target to sleep.

dragonKing.name: Dragon King
dragonKing.description: Boosts the power of Dragon-type moves by 60%.

dragonWrath.name: Dragon Wrath
dragonWrath.description: 50% chance to deal 1/6 of the attacker's max HP as damage when hit by a contact move.

dragonbaneSword.name: Dragonbane Sword
dragonbaneSword.description: Slicing moves deal 2.5x damage to Dragon-type Pokémon. When the user knocks out a Dragon-type Pokémon, the user gains +1 Speed and restores 1/8 of its max HP.

dragonbaneWrath.name: Dragonbane Wrath
dragonbaneWrath.description: While this is active, the target loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn if it is Dragon-type. Dragon-type moves deal 0.5x damage to the user.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.description: Turns Normal-type moves into Dragon-type moves and boosts their power by 20%.

drawThree.name: Draw Three
drawThree.description: At the end of each turn, three random stats are separately and randomly increased or decreased. Each stat change is independent of the others.

drawTime.name: Draw Time!
drawTime.description: When the user knocks out a target, there is a 5% chance to trigger reward selection.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.description: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

drought.name: Drought
drought.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

drySkin.name: Dry Skin
drySkin.description: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

dualBoneBlade.name: Dual Bone Blade
dualBoneBlade.description: The user's attacks hit twice, and the second hit deals 50% damage. The user's attacks use the opponent's lower Defense stat.

earlyBird.name: Early Bird
earlyBird.description: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

earthEater.name: Earth Eater
earthEater.description: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

earthSpeeder.name: Earth Speeder
earthSpeeder.description: Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by a Ground-type move.

earthboundCurse.name: Earthbound Curse
earthboundCurse.description: In rain, Water-type and Ground-type moves have a 30% chance to burn the target and lower the target's Speed by one stage. Normal-type moves change to either the Water or Ground type according to which would deal more damage (random if neutral).

ectoplasmicCharm.name: Ectoplasmic Charm
ectoplasmicCharm.description: 20% chance to infatuate the target when using a Ghost-type move if they are the opposite gender. 50% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

ectoplasmicTouch.name: Ectoplasmic Touch
ectoplasmicTouch.description: Damages the attacker by 1/12 of its max HP when hit by a contact move. Also damages the target by 1/12 of its max HP when using a contact move.

eerieLight.name: Eerie Light
eerieLight.description: Electric and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. Changes Water-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to confuse the target. 10% chance to paralyze the target.

effectSpore.name: Effect Spore
effectSpore.description: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.

eightBitBlaze.name: Eight Bit Blaze
eightBitBlaze.description: Boosts Fire-type moves when HP is low. 10% chance to trap the target in a fiery vortex. Changes Normal-type moves to Fire-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to burn the target.

eightBitHunger.name: Eight Bit Hunger
eightBitHunger.description: 50% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after attacking. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

eightBitTerror.name: Eight Bit Terror
eightBitTerror.description: Boosts nightmare-related moves by 20%. 10% chance to curse or make the target flinch. 10% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

electafireAbsorb.name: Electafire Absorb
electafireAbsorb.description: Heals HP when hit by Fire or Electric-type moves instead of taking damage.

electric.name: Electric
electric.description: Boosts Electric-type moves by 50%, takes double damage from Water, and changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type with 20% power.

electricDisguise.name: Electric Disguise
electricDisguise.description: The Pokemon is protected from damage when it enters a battle or when its HP is full. This protection is removed after the Pokemon takes damage. Electric-type moves charge this ability.

electricSurge.name: Electric Surge
electricSurge.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

electroBoogey.name: Electro Boogey
electroBoogey.description: Normal-type moves become Electric-type. Electric-type moves have a 30% chance to deal 2.5× damage and a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

electromagneticMaster.name: Electromagnetic Master
electromagneticMaster.description: Electric-, Rock-, and Steel-type moves share type advantages. Normal-type moves become Electric-, Rock-, or Steel-type based on which would deal the most damage (random if neutral). Electric-type moves have a 10% chance to gain +1 priority. Rock-type moves have a 5% chance to inflict Salt Cure. Steel-type moves have a 10% chance to land a critical hit.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

elementalBypass.name: Elemental Bypass
elementalBypass.description: If the opponent is a Water-, Ground-, or Fire-type, the user's attacks deal 1.5× damage.

elementalHavoc.name: Elemental Havoc
elementalHavoc.description: The target's Water-, Electric-, and Flying-type moves deal 0.5× damage. Normal-type moves become Water-, Flying-, or Electric-type based on which would deal the most damage (random if neutral). Water-, Electric-, and Flying-type moves deal 1.2× damage.

eliteStatic.name: Elite Static
eliteStatic.description: 50% chance to paralyze the attacker on contact. Lowers a random stat of the attacker by 1 stage on contact. Damages the attacker by 1/8 of its max HP when hit by a contact move.

embodyAspectCornerstone.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectCornerstone.description: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Cornerstone Mask to shine and the Pokémon's Defense stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectHearthflame.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectHearthflame.description: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Hearthflame Mask to shine and the Pokémon's Attack stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectTeal.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectTeal.description: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Teal Mask to shine and the Pokémon's Speed stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectWellspring.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectWellspring.description: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Wellspring Mask to shine and the Pokémon's Sp. Def stat to be boosted.

emeraldGear.name: Emerald Gear
emeraldGear.description: The user's Grass- and Steel-type moves share type weakness advantages. Normal-type moves become Grass-type and deal 1.2× damage. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Gadget move, Fire-type moves also share type weakness advantages with Grass and Steel.

emeraldStance.name: Emerald Stance
emeraldStance.description: When using an attack, the user uses its Defense stat rather than its Attack or Special Attack.

emergencyExit.name: Emergency Exit
emergencyExit.description: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

emperorsCoin.name: Emperor's Coin
emperorsCoin.description: Each turn, the user has a 50% chance to raise two unique random stats by one stage.

enforcer.name: Enforcer
enforcer.description: Dark and Steel-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Raises Attack by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

enhancedFocus.name: Enhanced Focus
enhancedFocus.description: 25% chance to land a critical hit.

enlightened.name: Enlightened
enlightened.description: Boosts Psychic-type moves by 20%. Moves that would be not very effective become neutral.

eradicatorsDomain.name: Eradicator's Domain
eradicatorsDomain.description: Whenever the target uses a Special move, it has a 30% chance to receive a random status condition. Whenever the target uses a status move, it takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP.

eternalGiggle.name: Eternal Giggle
eternalGiggle.description: Takes double damage from Mold Breaker. Confuses and makes all opposing Pokemon flinch when the user faints.

eternalYouth.name: Eternal Youth
eternalYouth.description: Boosts Fairy-type moves by 30%. Changes Normal-type moves to Fairy-type. Has a 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

etherealLight.name: Ethereal Light
etherealLight.description: The user has Intimidate. On switch-in, it clears all hazards placed by the target and removes all of the target's stat boosts.

evolutionPill.name: Evolution Pill
evolutionPill.description: When the user faints, the next Pokémon sent into battle gains +1 stage to its highest stat and restores 33% of its max HP.

exceptionCaught.name: Exception Caught
exceptionCaught.description: Survives a hit that would knock it out and then sharply lowers its Speed. Heals HP after being hit.

existence.name: Existence
existence.description: Boosts all moves by 20%, neutralizes super effective moves, and neutralizes moves that would be super effective against the target.

expandingMass.name: Expanding Mass
expandingMass.description: The user gains +10 base power to its moves for every turn it remains on the field, up to a maximum of +50, but loses 1/8 of its max HP each turn.

experienceBoost.name: Experience BOOST
experienceBoost.description: At the end of each turn, the user randomly raises either its Defense, Attack, or Speed by one stage.

experimentError.name: Experiment Error
experimentError.description: Lowers a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle. 10% chance to seed or trap the target in a whirlpool. 10% chance to burn the target. 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after attacking.

explosiveAir.name: Explosive Air
explosiveAir.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Flying-type and deal 1.2× damage. Flying-type moves used against Fire-type Pokémon always result in critical hits.

fairyAura.name: Fairy Aura
fairyAura.description: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.

fairyFear.name: Fairy Fear
fairyFear.description: Boosts Fairy-type moves by 20%. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

falseSafety.name: False Safety
falseSafety.description: Lowers Special Defense by 1 stage when entering battle. 10% chance to burn, put to sleep, or paralyze attackers on contact.

fancyCardboard.name: Fancy Cardboard
fancyCardboard.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Normal-type and boosts their power by 20%. Normal-type moves can hit Ghost-types. Boosts moves with 60 or less power by 50%.

fastFood.name: Fast Food
fastFood.description: The user's Speed is raised at the end of each turn. Biting moves receive a 1.2× boost.

fatedRevival.name: Fated Revival
fatedRevival.description: When the user faints, it revives a random fainted Fairy-type Pokémon in its party (excluding same species) with 50% HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

fieryDisguise.name: Fiery Disguise
fieryDisguise.description: The Pokemon is protected from damage when it enters a battle or when its HP is full. This protection is removed after the Pokemon takes damage. Fire-type moves charge this ability.

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

finalBlade.name: Final Blade
finalBlade.description: Non-flinching attacks gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch per fainted party member.

finalRound.name: Final Round
finalRound.description: Boosts the power of Fighting-type moves when HP is low.

fireAndIce.name: Fire & Ice
fireAndIce.description: The user's Normal-type moves become either Ice-type or Fire-type based on which type is more effective against the target (chosen at random if neutral). Fire-type moves have a 10% chance to freeze the target, and Ice-type moves have a 30% chance to burn the target.

fireRafRaf.name: Fire Raf Raf
fireRafRaf.description: Boosts Fire-type moves by 50%. Takes double damage from Water. Normal-type moves become Fire-type and are boosted by 20%.

fistOfFate.name: Fist of Fate
fistOfFate.description: The user's contact moves ignore resistances and Abilities. When the user knocks out a target, the next Pokémon switched in takes damage equal to 1/4 of its max HP.

flameBody.name: Flame Body
flameBody.description: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

flameForm.name: Flame Form
flameForm.description: Boosts Fire-type moves by 20%. Fire and Normal-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

flameSpirit.name: Flame Spirit
flameSpirit.description: 10% chance to burn the target. Instead of taking damage from Fire-type moves, raises two random stats by 1 stage.

flamingChakra.name: Flaming Chakra
flamingChakra.description: Changes non-Psychic-type moves to Fire-type. Boosts Fire-type moves by 50%. 10% chance to burn the target.

flamingEmission.name: Flaming Emission
flamingEmission.description: Fire and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

flamingOblivion.name: Flaming Oblivion
flamingOblivion.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Fire-type moves ignore type resistances and have a 30% chance to burn the target and trigger Fire Spin. When the user knocks out a burned target, the next Pokémon sent into battle loses 25% of its max HP.

flareBoost.name: Flare Boost
flareBoost.description: Powers up special attacks when the Pokémon is burned.

flashFire.name: Flash Fire
flashFire.description: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

flowerGift.name: Flower Gift
flowerGift.description: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.

flowerVeil.name: Flower Veil
flowerVeil.description: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

fogBody.name: Fog Body
fogBody.description: Whenever the user misses with an attack that has 50% or higher accuracy, its Attack stat rises by one stage and it recovers 1/8 of its HP.

fogBreath.name: Fog Breath
fogBreath.description: Normal-type moves become Water-type, deal 1.3× damage, and have a 30% chance to lower the target's evasion.

foolsCoin.name: Fool's Coin
foolsCoin.description: The Pokémon has a 50% chance to activate Wonder Guard.

foolsGold.name: Fool's Gold
foolsGold.description: Immune to status moves from other Pokemon. Dark and Steel-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

forScience.name: For Science!
forScience.description: At the end of each turn, one of the user's stats is randomly raised by two stages and one is lowered by one stage, and one of the target's stats is randomly raised by one stage and one is lowered by one stage.

forbiddenPower.name: Forbidden Power
forbiddenPower.description: The base power of all of the user's moves increases by 20 each time the user attacks consecutively without switching.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.description: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

foreheadTap.name: Forehead Tap
foreheadTap.description: Boosts moves with 60 or less power by 50%. 10% chance to make the target flinch when using moves with 60 or less power. 10% chance to paralyze the target when using moves with 60 or less power.

forestFury.name: Forest Fury
forestFury.description: Boosts the power of Grass-type moves by 150% when HP is below 50%.

forestGuardian.name: Forest Guardian
forestGuardian.description: In Grassy Terrain, the user's Speed is doubled, and its physical moves deal 1.2× damage. Slashing moves have a high critical-hit ratio.

forestTrickery.name: Forest Trickery
forestTrickery.description: Normal-type moves become Grass- or Fairy-type depending on which type is stronger (chosen at random if neutral), and they deal 1.2× damage. Grass-type moves have a 30% chance to set Grassy Terrain. Fairy-type moves have a 30% chance to set Misty Terrain.

foreverPartner.name: Forever Partner
foreverPartner.description: Boosts the power of all moves by 30%. Has a 40% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

fossilBarrier.name: Fossil Barrier
fossilBarrier.description: The target cannot use priority moves or stat-boosting moves. Normal-type moves become Rock-type and deal 1.2× damage.

fourOFour.name: Four O Four
fourOFour.description: 10% chance to completely avoid damage from attacks.

foxWisdom.name: Fox Wisdom
foxWisdom.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Psychic-type. Boosts Psychic-type moves by 30%. Fire and Psychic-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

frightfulCute.name: Frightful Cute
frightfulCute.description: Has a 33% chance to boost move power by 50% or halve the damage taken from attacks.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

frostyAbomination.name: Frosty Abomination
frostyAbomination.description: When the user's HP drops below 50%, the target takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP. Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. Ice-type moves become biting moves, deal 1.2× damage, and have a 10% chance to freeze the target.

fuelExchange.name: Fuel Exchange
fuelExchange.description: Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. Restores 1/4 of max HP when hit by a Grass-type move. Raises Defense by 1 stage when hit by a Dark-type move. Raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Fairy-type move. Raises Special Defense by 1 stage when hit by a Psychic-type move. Raises Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Ice-type move.

fullMetalBody.name: Full Metal Body
fullMetalBody.description: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

furCoat.name: Fur Coat
furCoat.description: Halves the damage from physical moves.

galacticAwakening.name: Galactic Awakening
galacticAwakening.description: When its HP falls below 50%, this Pokémon changes to the Stellar type. When its HP is below 50%, at the end of each turn, it raises one random stat.

galeWings.name: Gale Wings
galeWings.description: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is full.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.description: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

gemSiphon.name: Gem Siphon
gemSiphon.description: Fairy-type moves heal the user for 50% of the damage dealt. If the user's HP is full, it creates a Substitute, taking 25% of its HP.

gemstoneTrample.name: Gemstone Trample
gemstoneTrample.description: Normal-type moves become Ground-type, ignore Defense boosts, and deal 20% more damage.

genieMagic.name: Genie Magic
genieMagic.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type or Dark-type depending on which type is more effective against the target (chosen at random if neutral). Fire-type and Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to trigger a Wish effect on the next turn.

ghostify.name: Ghostify
ghostify.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 40%.

ghostlyMold.name: Ghostly Mold
ghostlyMold.description: 10% chance to badly poison the target on contact. Ghost and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 20%. Takes double damage from Mold Breaker.

giantImpact.name: Giant Impact
giantImpact.description: Fire-, Grass-, Water-, and Electric-type moves become Normal-type. Normal-type moves deal 1.3× damage and have a 30% chance to paralyze the target or make it flinch.

glacialPace.name: Glacial Pace
glacialPace.description: Lowers Speed by 2 stages when entering battle. Boosts Ice-type moves by 20%.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.description: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.

godFist.name: God Fist
godFist.description: Boosts the power of punching moves by 50%.

goldenClutch.name: Golden Clutch
goldenClutch.description: Normal-type and Fighting-type moves become Slicing moves. Slicing moves ignore resistances. Slicing moves that cannot cause flinching gain +1 priority and +1 critical hit stage.

goldenGaze.name: Golden Gaze
goldenGaze.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Psychic-type and deal 1.2× damage. The user's Psychic-type moves have a 30% chance to disable the target's last used move. The user's Psychic-type moves deal 1.3× damage when the target's last used move is disabled.

goldenGear.name: Golden Gear
goldenGear.description: The user's Electric- and Steel-type moves share type weakness advantages. Normal-type moves become Electric-type and deal 1.2× damage. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Gadget move, Grass-type moves also share type weakness advantages with Electric and Steel.

goldenLuck.name: Golden Luck
goldenLuck.description: 30% chance to land a critical hit.

goldenRadiance.name: Golden Radiance
goldenRadiance.description: When the user's HP goes below 10%, all stats are raised by 1 stage.

goldenSkillLink.name: Golden Skill Link
goldenSkillLink.description: Maximizes the number of times multi-hit moves hit. 5% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after attacking.

golemPlus.name: Golem Plus
golemPlus.description: Boosts the power of Rock-type moves by 30% and increases Defense by 30%.

goodAsGold.name: Good as Gold
goodAsGold.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

gorillaTactics.name: Gorilla Tactics
gorillaTactics.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

gothamsNightmare.name: Gotham's Nightmare
gothamsNightmare.description: Prevents the opponent from switching out. 20% chance to land a critical hit.

gottaGoFast.name: Gotta Go Fast
gottaGoFast.description: Doubles power if moving first. Takes double damage if moving second.

grassPelt.name: Grass Pelt
grassPelt.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

grassySurge.name: Grassy Surge
grassySurge.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

gravePower.name: Grave Power
gravePower.description: Boosts move power by 150% when HP is below 40%. 30% chance to badly poison the target.

gravityAxe.name: Gravity Axe
gravityAxe.description: The user traps all opposing Pokémon, removes Flying-type immunities, and has the effects of Moody.

greenSpaghettiMonster.name: Green Spaghetti Monster
greenSpaghettiMonster.description: 15% chance to trap the target when using a Grass-type move. Boosts Grass-type moves by 20%. 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage when using a Grass-type move.

grimNeigh.name: Grim Neigh
grimNeigh.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

groundFlame.name: Ground Flame
groundFlame.description: Changes Fire-type moves to Ground-type and boosts their power by 20%.

guardDog.name: Guard Dog
guardDog.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

gulpMissile.name: Gulp Missile
gulpMissile.description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

hadronEngine.name: Hadron Engine
hadronEngine.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

hammerKnockback.name: Hammer Knockback
hammerKnockback.description: The user's contact moves have a 30% chance to force the target to switch.

handReset.name: Hand Reset
handReset.description: When the user's HP drops below 50%, it cures its status conditions and its allies' status conditions, and it resets all stat changes on both Pokémon.

happyLittleAccidents.name: Happy Little Accidents
happyLittleAccidents.description: Boosts moves with 65-85 power by 50%. Boosts moves with 60 or less power by 75%.

harpieBoost.name: Harpie Boost
harpieBoost.description: The user's moves gain 15 base power for each other non-fainted Flying-type Pokémon in the party.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.description: May create another Berry after one is used.

hashSlingingSlasher.name: Hash Slinging Slasher
hashSlingingSlasher.description: Doubles the power of slicing moves.

hauntingBroadcast.name: Haunting Broadcast
hauntingBroadcast.description: Curses all opposing Pokemon when the user faints.

hauntingEcho.name: Haunting Echo
hauntingEcho.description: 30% chance to paralyze the target and deal 1/16 of its max HP as damage when using a Ghost-type move.

hauntingScythe.name: Haunting Scythe
hauntingScythe.description: Changes it's attacks to SPECIAL or PHYSICAL based on the opponent's weaker defense stat.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Sometimes heals an ally's status condition.

healthySoak.name: Healthy Soak
healthySoak.description: Raises Speed and Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.description: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.

heavenPiercer.name: "Heaven Piercer"
heavenPiercer.description: The user's Steel-type moves do 2x against Ground and Rock-type Pokémon. Normal moves are changed to Steel type and do 1.2x.

heavensJudgment.name: Heaven's Judgment
heavensJudgment.description: Lowers foe Attack on entry and when any foe enters or switches in. Attacks gain 10 BP for each party Pokémon that knows a Servant move.

heavyweightHopper.name: Heavyweight Hopper
heavyweightHopper.description: Normal-type moves become either Flying-type or Fighting-type, depending on which type is stronger against the target (chosen at random if neutral). Flying-type moves have a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fighting-type moves have a 5% chance to land a critical hit.

hellFlame.name: Hell Flame
hellFlame.description: Boosts the power of Fire-type moves by 50%.

heroicLeap.name: Heroic Leap
heroicLeap.description: Immune to Ground-type moves. Raises Attack by 1 stage when entering battle. Changes Normal-type moves to Flying-type and boosts their power by 20%.

heyLookAtMe.name: Hey Look at Me
heyLookAtMe.description: Lowers two random stats by 1 stage and raises a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle.

hokage.name: Hokage
hokage.description: Boosts Fire, Water, Flying, and Ground-type moves by 20%.

honeyGather.name: Honey Gather
honeyGather.description: The Pokémon gathers Honey after a battle. The Honey is then sold for money.

horribleCardboard.name: Horrible Cardboard
horribleCardboard.description: Changes all moves to Normal-type and boosts their power by 20%. Normal-type moves can hit Ghost-types. 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

horribleGhostCardboard.name: Horrible Ghost Cardboard
horribleGhostCardboard.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 20%. Ghost-type moves can hit Normal-types. 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

horrorShow.name: Horror Show
horrorShow.description: Prevents the opponent from switching out. Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

hungerSwitch.name: Hunger Switch
hungerSwitch.description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

hungryTroll.name: Hungry Troll
hungryTroll.description: 50% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after attacking. 50% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after attacking.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.description: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

hydraResilience.name: Hydra Resilience
hydraResilience.description: Survives a hit that would knock it out when at full HP. Blocks one-hit KO moves. Has a 25% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.description: Heals status conditions if it's raining.

hydroClone.name: Hydro Clone
hydroClone.description: When the user knocks out the target, it summons a Substitute with 25% of its max HP.

hydroSurge.name: Hydro Surge
hydroSurge.description: All of the user's moves are super effective against Fire-type Pokémon.

hyperCutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyperCutter.description: The Pokémon's proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

iceAge.name: Ice Age
iceAge.description: The user summons snow or hail. At the end of each turn, if snow or hail is active, it randomly lowers the target's Speed, highest Defense stat, or highest Attack stat.

iceBody.name: Ice Body
iceBody.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

iceFace.name: Ice Face
iceFace.description: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it hails.

iceKing.name: Ice King
iceKing.description: Boosts Ice-type moves by 50%. Changes Normal-type moves to Ice-type and boosts their power by 20%. 5% chance to freeze the target.

iceScales.name: Ice Scales
iceScales.description: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

idealForm.name: Ideal Form
idealForm.description: 10% chance for each: critical hit, halve damage taken, double move power, restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit or attacking.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.description: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon and prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.description: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in the party's last spot.

illusionWeaver.name: Illusion Weaver
illusionWeaver.description: Whenever the target uses a status move, the user has a 10% chance to create a Substitute, using 25% of its HP.

illusionist.name: Illusionist
illusionist.description: The user has a 30% chance to evade physical attacks.

imAPickle.name: I'm a Pickle
imAPickle.description: Heals HP when hit by Water-type moves. Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by Grass-type moves. Raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by Steel-type moves. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

imARealBoy.name: I'm a Real Boy
imARealBoy.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Normal-type and boosts their power by 20%. Changes non-Fairy and non-Grass-type moves to Normal-type and boosts their power by 30%. Lowers Attack and a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle.

imBlue.name: I'm Blue
imBlue.description: Boosts Water-type moves. Resists Fire, Water, and Steel-type moves. Boosts power by 50% against Fire, Ground, and Rock-type Pokemon.

imaginary.name: Imaginary
imaginary.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Fairy-type and boosts their power by 20%. 30% chance to halve damage from Physical moves.

immortalSlime.name: Immortal Slime
immortalSlime.description: The user is immune to status conditions and critical hits. Physical damage dealt to the user is reduced by 50%.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.description: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.description: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

industrialPower.name: Industrial Power
industrialPower.description: Boosts Electric, Steel, and Poison-type moves by 30%.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.description: Passes through the opposing Pokémon's barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.

infinityStones.name: Infinity Stones
infinityStones.description: Normal-type moves become Rock-type moves. Rock-type moves have a 10% chance to land a critical hit, a 10% chance to inflict a random status condition, and heal the user for 25% of the damage dealt.

infomercialFame.name: Infomercial Fame
infomercialFame.description: Raises all stats by 1 stage when entering battle. 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP at the end of each turn.

inkBlindness.name: Ink Blindness
inkBlindness.description: Has a 35% chance to confuse the target after attacking.

inkFry.name: Ink Fry
inkFry.description: Lowers the target's Speed and Special Defense by 1 stage after using a Water-type move.

innardsOut.name: Innards Out
innardsOut.description: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

innerFocus.name: Inner Focus
innerFocus.description: The Pokémon's intensely focused, and that protects the Pokémon from flinching.

insectInfusion.name: Insect Infusion
insectInfusion.description: 50% chance to infest the target for 5 turns.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.description: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.

insomniaInk.name: Insomnia Ink
insomniaInk.description: 50% chance to give the target the Comatose ability or the Nightmare status.

intellyLectAlly.name: Intelly Lect Ally
intellyLectAlly.description: Raises Special Attack by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.description: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.

intrepidSword.name: Intrepid Sword
intrepidSword.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

ironBarbs.name: Iron Barbs
ironBarbs.description: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.

ironGiant.name: Iron Giant
ironGiant.description: Steel-type and Fighting-type moves deal 1.3× damage and have a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by one stage.

ironJaws.name: Iron Jaws
ironJaws.description: Biting moves heal the user for 50% of the damage dealt and share Steel type weakness advantages.

jellyfishFever.name: Jellyfish Fever
jellyfishFever.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Fire-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to badly poison the target when using a Special move. 10% chance to burn the target when using a Physical move. Fire and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

jujutsuSorcerer.name: Jujutsu Sorcerer
jujutsuSorcerer.description: Boosts move power by 150% when the user or target has a status condition. 20% chance to cure own or target's status. 30% chance to inflict a random status. Ignores Attack drop from burn. 50% chance to inflict a random status on self if not already statused.

junkToTreasure.name: Junk to Treasure
junkToTreasure.description: Moves with 45 base power or less deal 3× as much damage.

jurassicJaws.name: Jurassic Jaws
jurassicJaws.description: Normal-type moves become Ground-type moves. Ground-type moves become Biting moves. Biting moves hit twice, and the second hit deals 80% damage.

justAJerk.name: Just a Jerk
justAJerk.description: Lowers Defense by 1 stage when entering battle. Boosts Dark-type moves by 20%.

justAMaskedJerk.name: Just a Masked Jerk
justAMaskedJerk.description: Lowers Defense and a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle. Boosts the power of all moves by 20%.

justified.name: Justified
justified.description: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.

keenEye.name: Keen Eye
keenEye.description: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's accuracy.

kickPunch.name: Kick Punch
kickPunch.description: Boosts the power of kicking and punching moves by 30%.

kingsRoar.name: King's Roar
kingsRoar.description: When the user switches in normally, it lowers the target's Attack and Speed by one stage. When it switches in after a party member was knocked out, it lowers all of the target's stats by one stage.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.description: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

knightsShovel.name: Knight's Shovel
knightsShovel.description: Doubles the power of Ground and Steel-type moves if the user shares a weakness with the target. Immune to Ground-type moves.

knockout.name: Knockout
knockout.description: 35% chance to land a critical hit when HP is below 50%.

lasagna.name: Lasagna
lasagna.description: Restores 1/2 of max HP when HP drops below 50%. Only activates once per battle.

laserBusterCannon.name: Laser Buster Cannon
laserBusterCannon.description: Pulse and aura moves gain +1 priority and deal 1.3× damage.

lastHope.name: Last Hope
lastHope.description: Boosts the power of all moves when HP is low.

lastLaugh.name: Last Laugh
lastLaugh.description: Deals 1/4 of the attacker's max HP as damage when fainting.

lastSamufrog.name: Last Samufrog
lastSamufrog.description: Normal moves turn into Slicing moves and have high crit rate. Has sturdy effect.

lazyMight.name: Lazy Might
lazyMight.description: Boosts the power of all moves when HP is low.

leafDancer.name: Leaf Dancer
leafDancer.description: Raises a random stat by 1 stage after using a Dark-type move. Raises a random stat by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

leafGuard.name: Leaf Guard
leafGuard.description: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

leafyLure.name: Leafy Lure
leafyLure.description: 50% chance to halve damage from super effective moves. 50% chance to deal damage equal to 1/4 of the attacker's max HP when hit by a super effective move. 50% chance to restore 1/6 of max HP when hit by a super effective move.

leechVines.name: Leech Vines
leechVines.description: Doubles the power of Vine Whip. 30% chance to seed or bind the target when using Vine Whip.

leftoversPower.name: Leftovers Power
leftoversPower.description: Passively restores 1/8 of max HP at the end of each turn.

leviathansDomain.name: Leviathan's Domain
leviathansDomain.description: Water-type and Dragon-type moves always summon Rain when they hit. Each consecutive turn Rain is active, this Pokémon's Water-type and Dragon-type moves gain +10 base power, up to a maximum of +50.

leviathansWrath.name: Leviathan's Wrath
leviathansWrath.description: Water-type moves always land critical hits while Rain is active. After one of this Pokémon's moves lands a critical hit, the current weather is cleared.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.description: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

libero.name: Libero
libero.description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.

lierLyer.name: Lier Lyer
lierLyer.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. Fairy and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Has a 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

lifeAdvice.name: Life Advice
lifeAdvice.description: Raises a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle. 40% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP when hit by an attack.

lifeExchange.name: Life Exchange
lifeExchange.description: Once per battle, after this Pokémon defeats an opposing Pokémon, it revives a random fainted party member with 50% of its maximum HP.

lightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningRod.description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

limber.name: Limber
limber.description: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.

limitedEdition.name: Limited Edition
limitedEdition.description: Raises two random stats by 1 stage when entering battle. 33% chance to boost move power by 20%.

limitedTime.name: Limited Time
limitedTime.description: Badly poisons itself when entering battle. 30% chance to triple move power. Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

lingeringAroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingeringAroma.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

liquidOoze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidOoze.description: The oozed liquid has a strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.

liquidVoice.name: Liquid Voice
liquidVoice.description: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

livingDelicacy.name: Living Delicacy
livingDelicacy.description: Raises two random stats by 1 stage when entering battle. 33% chance to boost move power by 50%. 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP when hit by an attack.

longForgotten.name: Long Forgotten
longForgotten.description: Lowers Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage when entering battle.

longReach.name: Long Reach
longReach.description: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

looneyDragon.name: Looney Dragon
looneyDragon.description: Dragon-type moves have a 30% chance to confuse the target. Fairy-type moves have a 30% chance to lower a random stat of the target. This Pokémon gains +1 evasion when sent into battle.

looseThreads.name: Loose Threads
looseThreads.description: 30% chance to trap the target. Quintuples the power of binding moves.

lovePower.name: Love Power
lovePower.description: 50% chance to double move power. 30% chance to infatuate the target if they are the opposite gender.

lovelyStatic.name: Lovely Static
lovelyStatic.description: 30% chance to paralyze the attacker on contact. 30% chance to raise Special Attack by 1 stage after using an Electric-type move. 20% chance to infatuate the target when using a Fairy-type move if they are the opposite gender.

loversCoin.name: Lovers' Coin
loversCoin.description: Attacks have a 50% chance to infatuate opposing gendered Pokémon. If an infatuated target attacks, there is a 50% chance to deal half of the damage received back to the target.

luchadorsSpirit.name: Luchador's Spirit
luchadorsSpirit.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Flying-type and boosts their power by 20%. Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

luckySeven.name: Lucky Seven
luckySeven.description: 70% chance to boost moves with 70 base power by 70%. 70% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after attacking.

lusterGenesis.name: Luster Genesis
lusterGenesis.description: If the user's party has one fainted Dark-type Pokémon, the user's attacks hit twice, and the second hit deals 50% damage. If the user's party has one fainted Fairy-type Pokémon, moves with 60 base power deal 1.5× damage. If the user's party has one fainted Dark-type Pokémon, one fainted Fairy-type Pokémon, and one fainted Dark/Fairy-type Pokémon (three in total), attacks have a 30% chance to inflict a random status condition on the target. Each fainted Pokémon is counted at most once.

machSpeed.name: Mach Speed
machSpeed.description: During the first turn it is out, its Speed and Attack are doubled.

madeOfIce.name: Made of Ice
madeOfIce.description: 30% chance to freeze attackers on contact. Boosts Ice-type moves by 30%.

madeToLast.name: Made to Last
madeToLast.description: Has a 40% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out. 30% chance to raise Speed by 1 stage after using a Rock-type move. 10% chance to trap the target when using a Fairy-type move.
