magicBounce.name: Magic Bounce
magicBounce.description: Reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

magicGuard.name: Magic Guard
magicGuard.description: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

magicalInheritance.name: Magical Inheritance
magicalInheritance.description: The user gains a 10% Special Attack boost for each party Pokémon that knows a Dark Magic move. Fairy-type moves heal the user for 10% of damage dealt, multiplied by the number of fainted Fairy-type Pokémon in the party.

magicalWater.name: Magical Water
magicalWater.description: Changes Water-type moves to Fairy-type and boosts their power by 20%.

magician.name: Magician
magician.description: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.

magiciansCoin.name: Magician's Coin
magiciansCoin.description: When either Pokémon uses a status move, this Pokémon has a 50% chance to raise its Special Attack or restore 1/8 of its maximum HP.

magmaArmor.name: Magma Armor
magmaArmor.description: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

magnetPull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetPull.description: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping using its magnetic force.

magnetizeBeta.name: Magnetize Beta
magnetizeBeta.description: Electric-type moves heal the user for 25% of the damage dealt. Steel-type moves deal 1.2× damage. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Magnet move, this Pokémon gains +1 Attack and +1 Special Attack when switching out.

marvelScale.name: Marvel Scale
marvelScale.description: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.

mascotForm.name: Mascot Form
mascotForm.description: Boosts Electric-type moves by 20%. Electric and Normal-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

maskOfRemnants.name: Mask of Remnants
maskOfRemnants.description: When this Pokémon faints, it traps and curses the attacker.

maskedGod.name: Masked God
maskedGod.description: Based on Mask moves in the party, the user gains the following effects. With 1 or more: Normal-type moves are treated as Dark, Ghost, or Psychic depending on which type is strongest (random if neutral). With 2 or more: Dark-, Ghost-, and Psychic-type moves heal the user for 25% of the damage dealt. With 3 or more: The user takes 25% less damage from moves. With 5 or more: Dark-type moves have a 10% chance to inflict sleep, Ghost-type moves have a 5% chance to curse the target, and Psychic-type moves have a 10% chance to lower the target's Defense and Special Defense by one stage. With 10 or more: Dark-, Ghost-, and Psychic-type moves share their type advantage against the same types.

maskedMight.name: Masked Might
maskedMight.description: Doubles Attack and Special Attack when HP is above 50%.

masterOfIllusions.name: Master of Illusions
masterOfIllusions.description: At the end of each turn, the user has a 20% chance to create a Substitute.

masterOfTheDarkArts.name: Master of the Dark Arts
masterOfTheDarkArts.description: Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to inflict chip damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP (Wrap). Normal-type moves become Dark-type when that typing would be super effective against the target.

mastersBlade.name: Master's Blade
mastersBlade.description: All Normal-type moves are slashing moves. Slashing moves deal 1.5× damage and have +1 critical-hit ratio.

maternalShade.name: Maternal Shade
maternalShade.description: Has a 50% chance to quarter the damage of incoming attacks.

maxDestruction.name: MAX Destruction
maxDestruction.description: The user is immediately cured of status conditions. The user's moves hit twice; the second hit deals 50% damage. However, if the target has higher Defense than Attack, the second hit deals full damage.

mayITakeYourOrder.name: May I Take Your Order
mayITakeYourOrder.description: Moves used by this Pokemon go first.

mcpuzzle.name: McPuzzle
mcpuzzle.description: 20% chance to confuse the target. 10% chance to make the target flinch. 20% chance to boost move power by 150%. Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

megaLauncher.name: Mega Launcher
megaLauncher.description: Powers up aura and pulse moves.

megaSol.name: Mega Sol
megaSol.description: The Pokémon uses its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

memeArmor.name: Meme Armor
memeArmor.description: 50% chance to halve damage from attacks. Raises a random stat by 1 stage and lowers a random stat by 1 stage after being hit by an attack.

memeified.name: Memeified
memeified.description: Has a 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out. 20% chance to double the power of Special moves.

memoriesOfTennis.name: Memories of Tennis
memoriesOfTennis.description: Boosts the power of ball, sphere, orb, circle, bounce, and yellow-related moves by 50%. 30% chance to make the target flinch when using these moves.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.description: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

meteorProof.name: Meteor Proof
meteorProof.description: Reduces damage from Water, Rock, Fire, and Ice-type moves by 25%.

meteorShower.name: Meteor Shower
meteorShower.description: Normal-type, Fire-type, and Rock-type moves hit three times at 40% base power, with each hit randomly becoming Fire-type or Rock-type.

midnightCookies.name: Midnight Cookies
midnightCookies.description: 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP at the end of each turn. 30% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

midnightCookiesOfDeath.name: Midnight Cookies of Death
midnightCookiesOfDeath.description: 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP at the end of each turn. 30% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

millEngine.name: Mill Engine
millEngine.description: At the end of each turn, if the Pokémon is holding a Berry, it consumes a random Berry and raises its Attack by one stage. If its Attack is at +3 stages at the end of the turn, its Attack stat stage is reset to 0 and it restores 30% of its maximum HP.

millennialWeapon.name: Millennial Weapon
millennialWeapon.description: The user's Defense is multiplied by 1.5. Normal-type moves become either Fairy-type or Rock-type, depending on which type would deal more damage (chosen at random if neutral). Fairy-type and Rock-type moves use the user's Defense stat instead of Attack or Special Attack.

millenniumAbsorption.name: Millennium Absorption
millenniumAbsorption.description: When the user is hit by a contact move, the attacker loses HP equal to 50% of the damage taken by the user. When the user knocks out the target, it restores 25% of its HP and copies the target's Ability as a passive, overwriting the user's existing passive for the battle.

millenniumStalker.name: Millennium Stalker
millenniumStalker.description: When the user defeats the target, its Attack and a random stat are raised by one stage, and its status condition is cleared.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.description: Changes the Pokémon's type depending on the terrain.

mindTrance.name: Mind Trance
mindTrance.description: If the target has a status condition or volatile state (such as confusion or infatuation), the user's moves gain priority, and moves that cannot normally cause flinching have a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

mindWarp.name: Mind Warp
mindWarp.description: Normal-type moves become either Dark-type or Psychic-type depending on which type is more effective (chosen at random if neutral). Psychic-type moves have a 30% chance to confuse the target, and Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

mindlessRampage.name: Mindless Rampage
mindlessRampage.description: The effects of Sheer Force apply. When the user damages the target, its Speed or Attack is raised by one stage. However, the user cannot use status moves. At the end of each turn, the user takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP.

mindsEye.name: Mind's Eye
mindsEye.description: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

minus.name: Minus
minus.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

mirrorArmor.name: Mirror Armor
mirrorArmor.description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

mirrorKing.name: Mirror King
mirrorKing.description: Upon entry, the user copies the target's Ability. When it retreats, it regains 33% of its HP.

miseryTouch.name: Misery Touch
miseryTouch.description: Changes a random stat of the target by 1 stage after attacking.

mistySurge.name: Misty Surge
mistySurge.description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

moldBreaker.name: Mold Breaker
moldBreaker.description: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

moldyTouch.name: Moldy Touch
moldyTouch.description: 10% chance to infest or badly poison the target on contact. Boosts Poison-type moves by 20%. Takes double damage from Mold Breaker.

moltenShackles.name: Molten Shackles
moltenShackles.description: The user traps the target and deals damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn.

monotoneMood.name: Monotone Mood
monotoneMood.description: Changes all moves to Normal-type. Boosts Normal-type moves by 20%. Normal-type moves can hit Ghost-types. 10% chance to make the target drowsy.

mooTime.name: Moo Time
mooTime.description: Raises Defense and Speed by 50% when HP is below 50%.

moody.name: Moody
moody.description: Raises one stat sharply and lowers another every turn.

moonlitMischief.name: Moonlit Mischief
moonlitMischief.description: In night biomes, when this Pokémon switches in, all of its stats are raised by one stage.

moonsCoin.name: Moon's Coin
moonsCoin.description: When the user switches in, it sets Gravity for 5 turns. While Gravity is in effect, the user's Dark-type moves have a 50% chance to put the target to sleep, and its Psychic-type moves have a 50% chance to create a Substitute.

morphingBlaze.name: Morphing Blaze
morphingBlaze.description: Boosts Fire-type moves when HP is low. Changes Fire-type moves to Electric-type against Water-types and to Water-type against Ground-types when HP is below 50%.

motorDrive.name: Motor Drive
motorDrive.description: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move instead of taking damage.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.description: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.

mudiate.name: Mudiate
mudiate.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Ground-type and boosts their power by 20% and gives them 20% chance to lower the foe's accuracy.

multiGear.name: Multi Gear
multiGear.description: Raises Speed and a random stat by 1 stage when using Shift Gear.

multiMind.name: Multi Mind
multiMind.description: Fire and Psychic-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Psychic-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP.

multiPiece.name: Multi Piece
multiPiece.description: Survives a hit that would knock it out and then sharply lowers its Speed. Heals HP after being hit.

multiply.name: Multiply
multiply.description: The user's Normal-type moves have a 30% chance to create a Substitute and raise two random stats by one stage.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.description: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the Plate or Z-Crystal it holds.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.

muscleForm.name: Muscle Form
muscleForm.description: Boosts Fighting-type moves by 20%. Fighting and Normal-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

myceliumMight.name: Mycelium Might
myceliumMight.description: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

naturalCure.name: Natural Cure
naturalCure.description: All status conditions heal when the Pokémon switches out.

necroDrain.name: Necro Drain
necroDrain.description: When the user knocks out the target, a random non-fainted party member restores 25% of its HP.

necroSurge.name: Necro Surge
necroSurge.description: The user's moves gain 5 base power for each fainted party member.

neetProduced.name: NEET Produced
neetProduced.description: Takes double damage from Water and Normal-type moves. Increases item drops after battle. Doubles power against Normal, Fairy, and Fighting-type Pokemon.

nemoEater.name: Nemo Eater
nemoEater.description: Doubles move power against Water-type Pokemon. Restores 1/8 of max HP after knocking out a Water-type Pokemon. Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out a Water-type Pokemon.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.description: Powers up moves that are super effective.

neutralizingGas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizingGas.description: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

newAdaption.name: New Adaption
newAdaption.description: Halves damage from Fire and Ground-type moves. Doubles the power of Steel-type moves against Fire, Poison, and Water-type Pokemon.

nightAndDay.name: Night and Day
nightAndDay.description: Has a 40% chance to inflict burn on contact when HP is above 50%, or a 35% chance to inflict sleep on contact when HP is below 50%.

nightShow.name: Night Show
nightShow.description: Lowers a random stat of the opponent by 2 stages at the end of each turn.

nightStalker.name: Night Stalker
nightStalker.description: In night biomes, the user's moves gain +1 priority.

nightmarate.name: Nightmarate
nightmarate.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Primary-type and boosts their power by 20%.

nightmareClarinet.name: Nightmare Clarinet
nightmareClarinet.description: Changes all moves to sound-based and boosts their power by 20%. Boosts sound-based moves by 50%. 10% chance to curse the target.

nightmareEmerald.name: Nightmare Emerald
nightmareEmerald.description: Boosts Rock and Dark-type moves by 30%. 50% chance to give the target the Comatose ability or the Nightmare status.

nightmareFuel.name: Nightmare Fuel
nightmareFuel.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Primary-type and boosts their power by 20%.

nightmareHost.name: Nightmare Host
nightmareHost.description: 50% chance for moves to go first. 10% chance to paralyze, poison, or burn the target.

nightmareInk.name: Nightmare Ink
nightmareInk.description: 90% chance to give the target the Comatose ability or the Nightmare status.

nightmareSand.name: Nightmare Sand
nightmareSand.description: Deals damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP at the end of each turn during a sandstorm. 30% chance to lower a random stat of the target by 1 stage at the end of each turn during a sandstorm. 30% chance to change the weather to a sandstorm at the end of each turn.

nightmareSauce.name: Nightmare Sauce
nightmareSauce.description: 50% chance to give the target the Comatose ability. 30% chance to give the target the Nightmare status, if they have the Comatose ability.

nightmares.name: Nightmares
nightmares.description: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon by 1/4 at the end of each turn.

noGuard.name: No Guard
noGuard.description: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.description: All the Pokémon's moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

notShadow.name: Not Shadow
notShadow.description: Immune to Dark, Steel, and Ghost-type moves. Raises Attack, Defense, or Speed respectively when hit by a Dark, Steel, or Ghost-type move.

nuclearEnergy.name: Nuclear Energy
nuclearEnergy.description: Changes Poison-type moves to Electric-type and boosts their power by 20%.

oaksMistake.name: Oak's Mistake
oaksMistake.description: Lowers a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle. 10% chance to seed or trap the target in a whirlpool. 10% chance to burn the target. 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after attacking.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.description: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.

ohayogosumasu.name: Ohayogosumasu
ohayogosumasu.description: Lowers Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage when entering battle.

ojamaLockdown.name: Ojama Lockdown
ojamaLockdown.description: Prevents the opponent from switching or using status moves. If at least three party Pokémon have Ojama moves, one of the target's stats is reduced by 2 stages at the end of each turn.

ojamaMagic.name: Ojama Magic
ojamaMagic.description: If at least three party Pokémon have Ojama moves, this Pokémon's Normal-type and Ojama moves have a 30% chance to simultaneously taunt, torment, and confuse the target.

ojamaSolidarity.name: Ojama Solidarity
ojamaSolidarity.description: On entry, disables one of the target's moves. If at least 3 party Pokémon have Ojama moves, this Pokémon's Normal-type and Ojama move attacks gain priority and +1 critical hit stage.

omniscale.name: Omniscale
omniscale.description: 30% chance to halve damage taken from attacks. 30% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage when hit by an attack.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

organicTwist.name: Organic Twist
organicTwist.description: Grass and Rock-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

orichalcumPulse.name: Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcumPulse.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

originalAsmr.name: Original ASMR
originalAsmr.description: 20% chance to put the target to sleep. Reduces damage taken by 20%. Boosts sound-based moves by 30%. Halves damage from sound-based moves.

originalSkyKing.name: Original Sky King
originalSkyKing.description: Normal moves become Biting moves. Biting and Slicing moves become Steel or Flying type, whichever is more effective against the target (chosen at random if neither), and deal 1.2× damage. The user heals for 20% of the damage dealt.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.description: Protects the Pokémon from things like sand, hail, and powder.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

ownTempo.name: Own Tempo
ownTempo.description: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.

pacFungus.name: Pac Fungus
pacFungus.description: 30% chance to infest the target on contact. Raises Speed and Attack by 1 stage if the target is infested. Takes double damage from Mold Breaker.

parallelWorld.name: Parallel World
parallelWorld.description: On entry, swaps the target's Attack and Special Attack stats.

parentalHaunting.name: Parental Haunting
parentalHaunting.description: Changes non-Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 20%.

pastelVeil.name: Pastel Veil
pastelVeil.description: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

perishBody.name: Perish Body
perishBody.description: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

permafrostArmor.name: Permafrost Armor
permafrostArmor.description: Halves damage from Fire, Ice, and Rock-type moves.

phantomArmor.name: Phantom Armor
phantomArmor.description: The Pokémon is immune to contact moves.

phantomArsenal.name: Phantom Arsenal
phantomArsenal.description: Dark moves have 10% chance to set Spikes on the opponent's field. Rock moves have 10% chance to set Stealth Rock. Ghost moves have 5% chance to inflict Curse.

phantomBeast.name: Phantom Beast
phantomBeast.description: The user's evasion increases by 1 stage at the end of each turn. While the user has more than 1 stage of evasion, its moves gain +1 priority. When the target misses an attack and the user has more than 1 stage of evasion, the user's evasion is reset and one of the user's stats is increased by 1 stage.

phantomPouch.name: Phantom Pouch
phantomPouch.description: 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit or attacking. Increases item drops after battle.

phantomTorrent.name: Phantom Torrent
phantomTorrent.description: Boosts Water-type moves when HP is low. 30% chance to raise Special Attack by 1 stage after using a Water-type move. 10% chance to trap the target in a whirlpool when using a Fairy-type move.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.description: Steals an item from an attacker that made direct contact.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.description: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon held during a battle.

piercingDrill.name: Piercing Drill
piercingDrill.description: Contact moves bypass the target's protection and deal 1/4 of expected damage.

piercingSpiral.name: Piercing Spiral
piercingSpiral.description: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type or Fighting-type, depending on which type deals more damage (chosen at random if neutral). Dragon- and Fighting-type moves have a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense.

pixelatedTongue.name: Pixelated Tongue
pixelatedTongue.description: 30% chance to inflict a random status condition and lower a random stat of the target by 1 stage.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

plagueBreathe.name: Plague Breathe
plagueBreathe.description: If this Pokémon has less than 70% HP when it switches out, it poisons the target, with a 30% chance to badly poison the target.

plaguePsyche.name: Plague Psyche
plaguePsyche.description: Poison and Psychic-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Poison-type. 10% chance to confuse or poison the target.

plasmasDomain.name: Plasma's Domain
plasmasDomain.description: Nullifies all opposing Pokémon's abilities and move effects. When this Pokémon switches in, it raises up to two random stats that are lower than the opposing Pokémon's stats.

playfulBlaze.name: Playful Blaze
playfulBlaze.description: Boosts Fire-type moves when HP is low. 30% chance to raise Attack by 1 stage after using a Fire-type move. 10% chance to burn the target when using a Fairy-type move.

plus.name: Plus
plus.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

poisonHeal.name: Poison Heal
poisonHeal.description: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned instead of losing HP.

poisonKing.name: Poison King
poisonKing.description: Boosts the power of Poison-type moves by 60%.

poisonPoint.name: Poison Point
poisonPoint.description: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

poisonPuppeteer.name: Poison Puppeteer
poisonPuppeteer.description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

poisonTouch.name: Poison Touch
poisonTouch.description: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

polarizeAlpha.name: Polarize Alpha
polarizeAlpha.description: Electric-type moves become Rock-type and have 1.2× power. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Magnet move, this Pokémon gains +1 Defense and +1 Special Defense when it switches out.

popUp.name: Pop Up
popUp.description: Lowers Defense by 1 stage and raises Speed by 1 stage when entering battle.

portalBeast.name: Portal Beast
portalBeast.description: Whenever an opposing Pokémon switches in, this Pokémon gains +1 to two random stats. When this Pokémon switches, it restores 25% of its maximum HP.

positivity.name: Positivity
positivity.description: Boosts Electric-type moves by 20%. Has a 30% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out. 33% chance to halve damage from attacks.

powderKing.name: Powder King
powderKing.description: Normal-type moves become either Bug-type or Poison-type—whichever is stronger against the target (chosen at random if neutral)—and deal 1.2× damage. Bug- and Poison-type moves have a 50% chance with each hit to randomly inflict Poison, Sleep, Burn, or Paralysis.

powerConstruct.name: Power Construct
powerConstruct.description: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.

powerOfAlchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
powerOfAlchemy.description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

powerSpot.name: Power Spot
powerSpot.description: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.description: Gives priority to a status move.

prehistoricHunt.name: Prehistoric Hunt
prehistoricHunt.description: 30% chance to change weather to Rain each turn. Doubles Speed in Rain or Harsh Sunlight or Hail or Snow or Heavy Rain.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.

pressurePlay.name: Pressure Play
pressurePlay.description: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokemon by 2. Lowers Attack by 1 stage when entering battle.

prideOfWeak.name: Pride of Weak
prideOfWeak.description: KOing a foe grants +1 Speed and +1 to the user's stronger Attack stat. Moves with 60 BP or less deal 1.5× damage.

primordialSea.name: Primordial Sea
primordialSea.description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.

prismArmor.name: Prism Armor
prismArmor.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

propellerTail.name: Propeller Tail
propellerTail.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

protean.name: Protean
protean.description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

pseudoPerfection.name: Pseudo Perfection
pseudoPerfection.description: 10% chance for each: critical hit, halve damage taken, double move power, restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit or attacking.

pseudoScale.name: Pseudo Scale
pseudoScale.description: Halves damage taken when HP is full. Damages the attacker by 1/8 of its max HP when hit by a contact move.

psychicSurge.name: Psychic Surge
psychicSurge.description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

psychoForm.name: Psycho Form
psychoForm.description: Boosts Psychic-type moves by 20%. Psychic and Normal-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

psychoLeaf.name: Psycho Leaf
psychoLeaf.description: Changes Grass-type moves to Psychic-type and boosts their power by 20%.

punkRock.name: Punk Rock
punkRock.description: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

puppetMaster.name: Puppet Master
puppetMaster.description: Triples move power against Mimikyu and Shuppet. 20% chance to curse or bind Normal and Fighting-type Pokemon. 10% chance to halve damage taken from attacks.

purePower.name: Pure Power
purePower.description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

purifyingSalt.name: Purifying Salt
purifyingSalt.description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

pyroBullet.name: Pyro Bullet
pyroBullet.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Fire-type moves gain +1 priority.

quaker.name: Quaker
quaker.description: Ground-type moves can hit Flying-types. Boosts moves with 'quake' or 'magnitude' in their name by 50%.

quarkDrive.name: Quark Drive
quarkDrive.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

queenlyMajesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenlyMajesty.description: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

quickDraw.name: Quick Draw
quickDraw.description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

quickDrawV2.name: Quick Draw
quickDrawV2.description: The user's Bullet, Aura, Ball, and Pulse moves gain +1 priority and have 1.2× power.

quickFeet.name: Quick Feet
quickFeet.description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

quickHarvest.name: Quick Harvest
quickHarvest.description: At the end of each turn, there is a 30% chance to restore a used Berry. At the end of the battle, there is a 50% chance to generate a random Berry (Pickup for Berries).

radiatingGamma.name: Radiating Gamma
radiatingGamma.description: Normal-type moves become Steel-type and deal 1.2× damage. The user's attacks use its Defense stat for damage calculation. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Magnet move, the target loses 1/8 of its HP at the end of each turn.

rageSoul.name: Rage Soul
rageSoul.description: Boosts move power based on the number of fainted allies (up to 150% boost).

ragingAxe.name: Raging Axe
ragingAxe.description: Slashing moves deal 1.5× damage, become Fighting-type, ignore Defense boosts, and have a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rainDish.name: Rain Dish
rainDish.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

rapidFire.name: Rapid Fire
rapidFire.description: Normal-type moves become either Steel-type or Fire-type, depending on which type deals more damage to the target (chosen at random if neutral), and deal 1.2× damage. Steel-type and Fire-type moves have a 30% chance to gain +1 priority.

rappingRampage.name: Rapping Rampage
rappingRampage.description: Changes all moves to sound-based and boosts their power by 20%. Boosts sound-based moves by 50%. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.description: Intimidate or being hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move will scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.

realisticStatic.name: Realistic Static
realisticStatic.description: 50% chance to paralyze the attacker on contact. Lowers a random stat of the attacker by 1 stage on contact. Damages the attacker by 1/8 of its max HP when hit by a contact move.

reboundingHurricane.name: Rebounding Hurricane
reboundingHurricane.description: When the user switches in, its evasiveness is raised by one stage. If the user dodges an attack, it gains Wind Charge. Using a Normal-type or Flying-type move while Wind Charge is active forces the target to switch out after the move hits and depletes Wind Charge.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.description: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

recycleEnergy.name: Recycle Energy
recycleEnergy.description: 50% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit or attacking.

redMenace.name: Red Menace
redMenace.description: 5% chance to curse the target or 10% chance to burn the target on contact. Boosts Fire-type moves by 20%. Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by a Fire-type move. Takes double damage from Mold Breaker.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.description: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.description: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

regeneratorPlus.name: Regenerator Plus
regeneratorPlus.description: Restores 45% of max HP when switching out.

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.description: 30% chance to steal the target's held item and raise Attack by 1 stage. 30% chance to obtain an item after battle.

reversedPsychology.name: Reversed Psychology
reversedPsychology.description: Inverts stat changes. Inverts type effectiveness of moves.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.description: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.description: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

rksSystem.name: RKS System
rksSystem.description: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the memory disc it holds.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: Raises ALL stats by 1 stage when entering battle. Lowers a random stat by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

rockControl.name: Rock Control
rockControl.description: Sets up Stealth Rock when hit by a Physical move. Boosts Rock-type moves by 30%.

rockFortress.name: Rock Fortress
rockFortress.description: Reduces damage from super effective moves by 50%.

rockHead.name: Rock Head
rockHead.description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

rockRoll.name: Rock Roll
rockRoll.description: Boosts Rock-type moves by 20%. Boosts moves with 'roll' or 'spin' in their name by 75%. 20% chance to make the target flinch when using a move with 'roll' or 'spin' in its name.

rockSolidMeme.name: Rock Solid Meme
rockSolidMeme.description: Normal and Rock-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Reduces damage from super effective moves by 25%.

rocketImpact.name: Rocket Impact
rocketImpact.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Fire-type moves gain +1 critical-hit stage, and critical hits burn the target.

rockyHorrorShow.name: Rocky Horror Show
rockyHorrorShow.description: Prevents the opponent from switching out. Raises two random stats by 1 stage when entering battle.

roseGarden.name: Rose Garden
roseGarden.description: Clears foe hazards and foe screens on entry. Sets Grassy Terrain on entry. Grass moves have a 30% chance to lower foe Atk and Sp. Atk by 1 stage.

roughSkin.name: Rough Skin
roughSkin.description: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.

roundTrip.name: Round Trip
roundTrip.description: When the user switches out, it restores 20% of its maximum HP, and the Pokémon that switches in restores 20% of its maximum HP.

roundingError.name: Rounding Error
roundingError.description: Halves damage from moves with power divisible by 5 but not by 10. Boosts moves with power not divisible by 10 or divisible by 5 by 50%.

rubberMan.name: Rubber Man
rubberMan.description: Halves damage from Physical and Steel-type moves. Electric-type move immunity and raises Attack by 1 stage. Takes double damage from Water-type moves. Boosts Normal, Fighting, and Flying-type moves by 50%.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.description: Normal-type moves become Dark-type. Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to invert the target's stat changes and a 10% chance to land a critical hit.

runAway.name: Run Away
runAway.description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

sAndMummy.name: S&Mummy
sAndMummy.description: Contact moves have a 30% chance to inflict Wrap on the target. The user restores 1/16 of its max HP each turn.

sandCorruption.name: Sand Corruption
sandCorruption.description: Damages the attacker by 1/8 of its max HP and lowers its Speed by 1 stage if hit by a contact move.

sandForce.name: Sand Force
sandForce.description: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

sandRush.name: Sand Rush
sandRush.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

sandSpit.name: Sand Spit
sandSpit.description: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

sandStream.name: Sand Stream
sandStream.description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

sandVeil.name: Sand Veil
sandVeil.description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

sapSipper.name: Sap Sipper
sapSipper.description: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move instead of taking damage.

scaleArmor.name: Scale Armor
scaleArmor.description: Reduces damage from Water, Electric, Fire, and Grass-type moves by 25%.

scalesOfJustice.name: Scales of Justice
scalesOfJustice.description: Attacks deal 2.5× damage against Dark-type Pokémon.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.description: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

scorchedEarth.name: Scorched Earth
scorchedEarth.description: If terrain is active, Attack damage is increased by 1.5×. Has a 30% chance to destroy the terrain, raise Speed by one stage, and leave the target burned.

scorchingBurster.name: Scorching Burster
scorchingBurster.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Fire-type moves have a 30% chance to inflict a burn and have +1 critical-hit ratio. Water-type and Ice-type moves do not affect the user.

scorchingJustice.name: Scorching Justice
scorchingJustice.description: The user's attacking moves have a 30% chance to burn the target. Burned targets take 1.5× damage.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

screenCleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screenCleaner.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

screenSwim.name: Screen Swim
screenSwim.description: Steel and Water-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Restores 1/8 of max HP at the end of each turn during rain. 10% chance to make the target flinch. 30% chance to change the weather to rain at the end of each turn.

screepy.name: Screepy
screepy.description: Ghost-type moves can hit Normal-types. Boosts Ghost-type moves by 30%. Immune to Intimidate.

sculptedIce.name: Sculpted Ice
sculptedIce.description: Raises a random stat among Speed, Defense, and Attack by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

secretSauce.name: Secret Sauce
secretSauce.description: 10% chance to paralyze, burn, poison, or badly poison the target. 10% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP. 10% chance to apply various status conditions or effects.

seedEater.name: Seed Eater
seedEater.description: Heals HP when hit by Grass-type moves instead of taking damage. Doubles move power against Grass-type Pokemon. Restores 1/8 of max HP when attacking a Grass-type Pokemon. Restores 1/2 of max HP when hit by seed-based moves.

seedSower.name: Seed Sower
seedSower.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

selfDriving.name: Self Driving
selfDriving.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Psychic-type and boosts their power by 50%.

sentientAnt.name: Sentient Ant
sentientAnt.description: Raises stats by 1 or 2 stages depending on the opponent's highest stat. Raises Defense if opponent's highest stat is Attack, Special Defense if opponent's highest stat is Special Attack, Special Attack if opponent's highest stat is Special Defense, or Speed by 2 stages if opponent's highest stat is Speed.

sereneGrace.name: Serene Grace
sereneGrace.description: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.

shadowCharm.name: Shadow Charm
shadowCharm.description: Lowers Attack by 1 stage when entering battle. Prevents the opponent from switching out.

shadowFlame.name: Shadow Flame
shadowFlame.description: The user's Fire-type and Dark-type moves share type weakness advantages. The user's Normal-type moves become Dark-type and deal 1.2× damage.

shadowMartyr.name: Shadow Martyr
shadowMartyr.description: When the user faints, the Pokémon that replaces it restores 33% of its maximum HP and gains +1 stage boosts to its highest stat and one random stat.

shadowOfColossus.name: Shadow of Colossus
shadowOfColossus.description: Has a 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out. Boosts Ghost-type moves by 30%. Reduces damage taken by 15%.

shadowReach.name: Shadow Reach
shadowReach.description: The user's binding moves deal damage equal to 1/6 of the target's maximum HP at the end of each turn.

shadowShield.name: Shadow Shield
shadowShield.description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

shadowSlayer.name: Shadow Slayer
shadowSlayer.description: 30% chance to burn, poison, paralyze, or badly poison the target when using a Ghost or Steel-type move.

shadowSync.name: Shadow Sync
shadowSync.description: Raises the user's highest stats by 1 when the opponent's stat changes. Boosts the power of all moves by 20%.

shadowTag.name: Shadow Tag
shadowTag.description: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadow to prevent it from escaping.

sharinganActivated.name: Sharingan Activated
sharinganActivated.description: Changes the user's type to match it's attack.

sharinganMastery.name: Sharingan Mastery
sharinganMastery.description: 15% chance to deal damage equal to 1/8 of the target's max HP. 5% chance to quarter damage taken from attacks. 15% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after attacking.

sharkShred.name: Shark Shred
sharkShred.description: Damages the target by 1/8 of its max HP when using a contact move. Restores 1/8 of max HP when using a contact move.

shedSkin.name: Shed Skin
shedSkin.description: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

sheerForce.name: Sheer Force
sheerForce.description: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.

shellArmor.name: Shell Armor
shellArmor.description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

shellRepair.name: Shell Repair
shellRepair.description: Restores 1/4 of max HP when using Shell Smash. Raises Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage when using Shell Smash. Only activates once per battle.

shellShock.name: Shell Shock
shellShock.description: Water and Electric-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type and boosts their power by 20%. 10% chance to make the target flinch when using a Water or Normal-type move. 10% chance to paralyze the target when using a Water or Normal-type move.

shieldDust.name: Shield Dust
shieldDust.description: This Pokémon's dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.

shieldsDown.name: Shields Down
shieldsDown.description: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

shinyScale.name: Shiny Scale
shinyScale.description: 10% chance to completely avoid damage from attacks.

showAndTell.name: Show and Tell
showAndTell.description: Doubles move power if the move used is different from the last move used.

shredded.name: Shredded
shredded.description: 33% chance to double move power. Changes Water and Normal-type moves to Fighting-type and boosts their power by 20%.

silentAssassin.name: Silent Assassin
silentAssassin.description: At the end of each turn, the user's evasion rises by 1 stage, up to a maximum of 3 stages. When the user's evasion reaches 3 stages, it resets to 0 and all of the user's stats rise by 1 stage.

silentBlade.name: Silent Blade
silentBlade.description: When attacking, uses the foe's Speed stat as the basis for calculating defense.

sillyPressure.name: Silly Pressure
sillyPressure.description: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokemon. 30% chance to raise Attack by 1 stage after using a Psychic-type move. 10% chance to encore the target when using a Fairy-type move.

simple.name: Simple
simple.description: The stat changes the Pokémon receives are doubled.

skillLink.name: Skill Link
skillLink.description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

slayerSensei.name: Slayer Sensei
slayerSensei.description: Triples move power against Ghost and Dark-type Pokemon. Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

slimeAbsorb.name: Slime Absorb
slimeAbsorb.description: When the user defeats the target, it restores 1/4 of its maximum HP and raises a random stat.

slowStart.name: Slow Start
slowStart.description: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.

slushRush.name: Slush Rush
slushRush.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

smash22.name: Smash 22
smash22.description: Normal-type moves become either Fighting-type or Ghost-type, depending on which would deal more damage (chosen at random if neutral). Fighting-type moves have a 10% chance to swap the target's Defense and Special Defense stats. Ghost-type moves have a 10% chance to swap the target's Attack and Special Attack stats.

smittyxtvVirus.name: SmittyNugget Virus
smittyxtvVirus.description: Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent. 50% chance to lower a random stat of the target by 1 stage after attacking.

smugAura.name: Smug Aura
smugAura.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Poison-type and boosts their power by 20%. Psychic and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 10% chance to poison the target.

snakeScale.name: Snake Scale
snakeScale.description: 50% chance to reduce damage taken by 25%. 30% chance to badly poison attackers on contact.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.

snowCloak.name: Snow Cloak
snowCloak.description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

snowWarning.name: Snow Warning
snowWarning.description: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.

solarPower.name: Solar Power
solarPower.description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in harsh sunlight, but HP decreases every turn.

solarPowerPlus.name: Solar Power Plus
solarPowerPlus.description: Doubles Special Attack. 30% chance to change the weather to harsh sunlight at the end of each turn.

solidKong.name: Solid Kong
solidKong.description: Reduces damage from super effective moves by 50%.

solidRock.name: Solid Rock
solidRock.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

soulBurn.name: Soul Burn
soulBurn.description: 30% chance to burn the target. Deals 1/8 of the attacker's max HP as damage if they are burned.

soulCollector.name: Soul Collector
soulCollector.description: Boosts moves that match essence type. Collects the type of knocked out Pokemon. Loses essences when fainting.

soulDrain.name: Soul Drain
soulDrain.description: 10% chance to collect the type of the move used. Lowers two random stats of the target by 2 stages if the move type matches a essence type. Loses essence types when fainting.

soulEater.name: Soul Eater
soulEater.description: The user restores HP when it uses a move that matches an essence type. It collects the type of knocked-out Pokémon. It loses essences when it faints.

soulHeart.name: Soul-Heart
soulHeart.description: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.

soulTax.name: Soul Tax
soulTax.description: At the end of each turn, the opposing Pokémon loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

spectralMist.name: Spectral Mist
spectralMist.description: Ghost-type moves have a 30% chance to curse the target. At the end of each turn, the user has a 25% chance to restore 1/8 of its maximum HP.

speedBoost.name: Speed Boost
speedBoost.description: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.

spellDrain.name: Spell Drain
spellDrain.description: The user has a 30% chance to negate the target's status moves. When a status move is negated, the user restores 15% of its maximum HP and raises a random stat by one stage.

spellbreakerBlade.name: Spellbreaker Blade
spellbreakerBlade.description: When the user enters battle, it gains a random status condition (excluding sleep and freezing). When it attacks while affected by a status condition, its attacks always land critical hits and its status condition is cured.

spellcastersFluff.name: Spellcaster's Fluff
spellcastersFluff.description: The user takes no damage from the first attack it receives each time it switches into battle.

spicySpray.name: Spicy Spray
spicySpray.description: Burns the attacker when the Pokémon takes damage.

spikedShell.name: Spiked Shell
spikedShell.description: When the user is hit by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/6 of the attacker's max HP. The user takes 50% less damage from physical moves.

spiritWinds.name: Spirit Winds
spiritWinds.description: Ghost and Grass-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Dark and Normal-type moves to Ghost-type and boosts their power by 20%.

splinterSkin.name: Splinter Skin
splinterSkin.description: Damages the attacker by 1/12 of its max HP when hit by a contact move. Also damages the target by 1/12 of its max HP when using a contact move.

spookySense.name: Spooky Sense
spookySense.description: Reduces damage from Ghost and Dark-type moves by 25%. Raises Attack and Speed by 1 stage if the opponent has a super effective move.

squeezer.name: Squeezer
squeezer.description: Quintuples the power of Wrap. 30% chance to trap the target.

squidlyStep.name: Squidly Step
squidlyStep.description: Boosts sound-based moves and kicking moves by 30%. Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by a Ground or Water-type move.

stabNormal.name: Stab Normal
stabNormal.description: Boosts the power of Normal-type moves by 30%.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.description: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.

stall.name: Stall
stall.description: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.description: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.

stanceChange.name: Stance Change
stanceChange.description: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.

static.name: Static
static.description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.

staticCharge.name: Static Charge
staticCharge.description: Applies the Charged status to the attacker on contact. 30% chance to paralyze on contact.

staticShock.name: Static Shock
staticShock.description: Normal-type moves become Electric-type. Electric-type moves gain +1 priority.

staticTaste.name: Static Taste
staticTaste.description: Boosts move power by 50% against paralyzed targets. 35% chance to paralyze the target.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: The Pokémon's determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.

steadfastBulk.name: Steadfast Bulk
steadfastBulk.description: 30% chance to get flinched when attacked. when flinched raises Speed by 2 stages and Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

steadyStance.name: Steady Stance
steadyStance.description: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, and Special Defense by 20%.

stealthShipping.name: Stealth Shipping
stealthShipping.description: 50% chance to set up Spikes, 20% chance for Stealth Rock, 20% chance for Toxic Spikes, or 10% chance for Sticky Web when hit by a contact move.

steamEngine.name: Steam Engine
steamEngine.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat drastically if hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

steamify.name: Steamify
steamify.description: Changes Water-type moves to Fire-type and boosts their power by 20%.

steelStealer.name: Steel Stealer
steelStealer.description: Raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Steel-type move.

steelySpirit.name: Steely Spirit
steelySpirit.description: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

stench.name: Stench
stench.description: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

stickyHold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyHold.description: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

stormDrain.name: Storm Drain
stormDrain.description: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

strawhat.name: Strawhat
strawhat.description: Has a 15% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out. Boosts move power based on the number of fainted allies (up to 100% boost).

streetSmart.name: Street Smart
streetSmart.description: Boosts Steel, Dark, Normal, and Fighting-type moves by 20%.

stretchy.name: Stretchy
stretchy.description: 50% chance to WRAP the target, preventing it from switching out and damaging it each turn.

strongJaw.name: Strong Jaw
strongJaw.description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

stubbornStance.name: Stubborn Stance
stubbornStance.description: Has a 70% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.

suctionCups.name: Suction Cups
suctionCups.description: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.

sugarRush.name: Sugar Rush
sugarRush.description: Moves go first when HP is above 50%. Boosts move power by 20% when HP is above 50%.

sumoMaster.name: Sumo Master
sumoMaster.description: Boosts Fighting-type moves by 30%. Changes Normal-type moves to Ground-type and boosts their power by 30%.

sunAndMoon.name: Sun and Moon
sunAndMoon.description: Boosts the power of Fire-type and Rock-type moves by 20%.

sunbather.name: Sunbather
sunbather.description: Fire and Water-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Water-type and boosts their power by 20%. Restores 1/8 of max HP at the end of each turn during harsh sunlight. 30% chance to change the weather to harsh sunlight at the end of each turn.

superHungry.name: Super Hungry
superHungry.description: 50% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after attacking. 50% chance to raise a random stat by 1 stage after attacking.

superLuck.name: Super Luck
superLuck.description: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

supersweetSyrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweetSyrup.description: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

supremeOverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeOverlord.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

surgeSurfer.name: Surge Surfer
surgeSurfer.description: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

swampKing.name: Swamp King
swampKing.description: 30% chance to poison the target. Changes Normal-type moves to Water-type and boosts their power by 20%. Water and Poison-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

sweetVeil.name: Sweet Veil
sweetVeil.description: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.

swiftClaws.name: Swift Claws
swiftClaws.description: Boosts contact moves by 30%. 30% chance to raise Accuracy, Attack, or Speed by 1 stage when using a contact move.

swiftSwim.name: Swift Swim
swiftSwim.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

swordOfRuin.name: Sword of Ruin
swordOfRuin.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.description: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.description: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.

tabletsOfRuin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tabletsOfRuin.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tailCommand.name: Tail Command
tailCommand.description: Boosts the power of tail-related moves by 75%.

tangledFeet.name: Tangled Feet
tangledFeet.description: Raises evasiveness if the Pokémon is confused.

tanglingHair.name: Tangling Hair
tanglingHair.description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

technician.name: Technician
technician.description: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.

telekineticDisguise.name: Telekinetic Disguise
telekineticDisguise.description: The Pokemon is protected from damage when it enters a battle or when its HP is full. This protection is removed after the Pokemon takes damage. Psychic-type moves charge this ability.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.description: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.

teraForce.name: Tera Force
teraForce.description: Ground-type moves can hit Flying-types. Boosts Ground-type moves by 30%. Immune to Intimidate.

teraShell.name: Tera Shell
teraShell.description: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

teraShift.name: Tera Shift
teraShift.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

teraformZero.name: Teraform Zero
teraformZero.description: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.description: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

terrify.name: Terrify
terrify.description: Lowers the opponent's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when entering battle.

theAvatar.name: The Avatar
theAvatar.description: Boosts Fire, Water, Flying, and Ground-type moves by 20%.

theElderShadows.name: The Elder Shadows
theElderShadows.description: Ghost and Dark-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Changes Normal-type moves to Dark-type and boosts their power by 20%. 30% chance to deal damage equal to 1/16 of the target's max HP at the end of each turn. 30% chance to double move power. Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

theGrimMiller.name: The Grim Miller
theGrimMiller.description: Ghost-type moves deplete 2 PP from the target's last used move. Normal-type moves become Ghost-type moves.

theUndeadKing.name: The Undead King
theUndeadKing.description: When this Pokémon faints, it knocks out a random party Pokémon that knows a Servant move, if one exists, restores 50% of its HP, and raises two random stats.

thermalExchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermalExchange.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

thicc.name: Thicc
thicc.description: 30% chance to reduce damage taken by 25%.

thickFat.name: Thick Fat
thickFat.description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

thousandEyesLock.name: Thousand Eyes Lock
thousandEyesLock.description: While this ability is active, the target cannot switch out or use the same move twice in a row. Each turn, one random stat is lowered by one stage for the target, and the same stat is raised by one stage for the user.

thousandSouls.name: Thousand Souls
thousandSouls.description: On entry, this Pokémon copies one random fainted party member's Ability and restores 1/8 of its HP.

thousandYears.name: Thousand Years
thousandYears.description: Each turn, one random stat of the target is lowered by one stage. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Time move, two random stats of the target are lowered by one stage.

threeHeadedBite.name: Three-Headed Bite
threeHeadedBite.description: Normal-type moves change to Dark-type or Fire-type, whichever is stronger against the target (chosen at random if neutral). Dark-type and Fire-type moves become biting moves and hit three times at 40% power.

thunderAndFire.name: Thunder and Fire
thunderAndFire.description: Fire and Electric-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

timeRoulette.name: Time Roulette!
timeRoulette.description: When the user attacks, there is a 50% chance the attack deals three times the damage. Otherwise, the user takes recoil equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

timeWizardsBlessing.name: Time Wizard's Blessing
timeWizardsBlessing.description: At the end of each turn, one random stat is raised. If at least two other party Pokémon have a Time-type move, the user also restores 1/8 of its max HP and raises another random stat.

timelineMagic.name: Timeline Magic
timelineMagic.description: When receiving damage, the user uses whichever Defense stat is higher. When dealing damage, the target uses whichever Defense stat is lower.

tintedLens.name: Tinted Lens
tintedLens.description: The Pokémon can use "not very effective" moves to deal regular damage.

tombRaider.name: Tomb Raider
tombRaider.description: Normal-type moves become Dark-type and deal 1.2× damage. Dark-type moves have a 30% chance to steal the target's held item. While holding an item, the user's Speed is raised by one stage upon entering battle, and its Dark-type moves deal 1.3× damage.

tooLate.name: Too Late
tooLate.description: Moves always go last. 35% chance to confuse, make drowsy, infest, or curse the target.

toonChaos.name: Toon Chaos
toonChaos.description: Normal-type moves become either Fairy-type or Dark-type, depending on which type is stronger (chosen at random if neutral). Fairy-type and Dark-type moves deal 1.2× damage and have a 30% chance to force the target to switch.

toonElectricArchfiend.name: Toon Electric Archfiend
toonElectricArchfiend.description: Normal-type moves become either Electric-type or Dark-type, depending on which type is stronger (chosen at random if neutral). Electric-type moves have a 30% chance to gain +1 priority. Dark-type moves have a 10% chance to land a critical hit.

toonGunslinger.name: Toon Gunslinger
toonGunslinger.description: The user's Normal-type, Dragon-type, Dark-type, and Fairy-type moves have a 50% chance to gain +1 priority and a 10% chance to land a critical hit.

toonIllusion.name: Toon Illusion
toonIllusion.description: When the target misses an attack, the user has a 30% chance to create a Substitute with 25% of its max HP. When the user switches in, its evasion is raised by one stage.

toonPlotArmor.name: Toon Plot Armor
toonPlotArmor.description: Normal-type moves become Water-type. Water-type moves have a 10% chance to trigger a Protect effect.

toonPounding.name: Toon Pounding
toonPounding.description: Instead of using the target's Defense stat, Steel-type and Fairy-type attacks use the target's lowest stat during damage calculation.

toonSynergy.name: Toon Synergy
toonSynergy.description: Normal-type moves become either Psychic-type or Fairy-type depending on which type is stronger (chosen at random if neutral). Psychic-type and Fairy-type attacks have a 10% chance per Pokémon with Toon moves to raise all of the user's stats.

topazLifeorb.name: Topaz Lifeorb
topazLifeorb.description: The user's attacks deal 1.3× damage and have a 10% chance to raise Attack, but the user takes 15% damage with each attack.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

torrentialTribute.name: Torrential Tribute
torrentialTribute.description: When the user switches in, it immediately becomes Water Charged. If the user is hit by a move while Water Charged, the user takes no damage and the attacker takes 1/8 of its max HP instead; both effects occur only once per battle. Normal-type moves become Water-type and deal 1.2× damage.

toughClaws.name: Tough Claws
toughClaws.description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

toxicBoost.name: Toxic Boost
toxicBoost.description: Powers up physical attacks when the Pokémon is poisoned.

toxicChain.name: Toxic Chain
toxicChain.description: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

toxicCombustion.name: Toxic Combustion
toxicCombustion.description: Deals 1/8 of the attacker's max HP as damage if they are badly poisoned. 30% chance to badly poison the target.

toxicDebris.name: Toxic Debris
toxicDebris.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

toxicOverload.name: Toxic Overload
toxicOverload.description: 15% chance to badly poison the target. Boosts move power by 75% against poisoned or badly poisoned targets.

toxicTrance.name: Toxic Trance
toxicTrance.description: 30% chance to badly poison the target. 30% chance to put the target to sleep. Boosts move power by 50% when the user has a status condition.

trace.name: Trace
trace.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

travelBuddiesBlue.name: Travel Buddies Blue
travelBuddiesBlue.description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type. Flying-type moves gain +1 priority. If at least two other party Pokémon have Union moves, Flying-type moves also heal the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

travelBuddiesRed.name: Travel Buddies Red
travelBuddiesRed.description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type and gain +1 priority. If at least two other party Pokémon have Union moves, this Pokémon's moves also gain a 1.5× power boost.

treasureGuard.name: Treasure Guard
treasureGuard.description: Randomly reduces damage taken by 25-50%. 30% chance to restore 1/8 of max HP after being hit by an attack.

treasureProducer.name: Treasure Producer
treasureProducer.description: 50% chance to steal the target's held item. Increases item drops after battle. Moves always go last.

triage.name: Triage
triage.description: Gives priority to a healing move.

tripleBurst.name: Triple Burst
tripleBurst.description: Non-multi-hit attacks hit three times at 55% power each.

tripleCoreEngine.name: Triple Core Engine
tripleCoreEngine.description: All multi-hit moves hit act the same as triple accel (3 hits consective increase power, lower accuracy). Single-hit moves deal 1.2× damage.

tripleThreat.name: Triple Threat
tripleThreat.description: 10% chance to land a critical hit. 10% chance to make the target flinch. 10% chance to freeze, paralyze, or burn on contact.

truant.name: Truant
truant.description: The Pokémon can't use a move if it had used a move on the previous turn.

trueFear.name: True Fear
trueFear.description: Lowers a random stat of the opponent by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.description: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

twinBlessings.name: Twin Blessings
twinBlessings.description: Secondary effect chances are doubled. Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and deal 1.2× damage. Fairy-type moves have a 30% chance to heal for 50% of the damage dealt.

twinCoreBurst.name: Twin Core Burst
twinCoreBurst.description: If the user has a status condition, moves have a 30% chance to hit twice and cure the status condition.

twistedLove.name: Twisted Love
twistedLove.description: The user only takes damage from super effective moves. The user cannot be healed (berries, moves, and items have no effect). After attacking, it deals damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP to the target. Each turn, the user loses 1/4 of its max HP.

twoHalves.name: Two Halves
twoHalves.description: Survives a hit that would knock it out and then sharply lowers foe's Speed, and restores 50% HP.

tyrantsCoin.name: Tyrant's Coin
tyrantsCoin.description: The user's non-multi-hit damaging moves have a 50% chance to hit twice and a 50% chance to inflict recoil damage equal to 20% of its maximum HP to the user instead.

ugly.name: Ugly
ugly.description: Lowers a random stat by 1 stage when entering battle and at the end of each turn. 10% chance to make the target flinch.

ultimateAdaptation.name: Ultimate Adaptation
ultimateAdaptation.description: Boosts the power of all moves by 20%. Super effective moves become neutral against this Pokemon.

ultimateDefense.name: Ultimate Defense
ultimateDefense.description: All moves deal 50% less damage, but this Pokémon cannot use status moves.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.description: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon's stat changes.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

uncontrollablePower.name: Uncontrollable Power
uncontrollablePower.description: Has Sturdy. If the user's HP is exactly 1, all of its moves gain +3 priority, deal double damage, and heal the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Has a 70% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

undeadArchfiend.name: Undead Archfiend
undeadArchfiend.description: This Pokémon is unaffected by the target's status moves or secondary effects. Normal-type moves become Ghost-type and deal 1.2× damage.

undeadAvenger.name: Undead Avenger
undeadAvenger.description: Gains +10% Atk and Spd per fainted party member.

underworldThicket.name: Underworld Thicket
underworldThicket.description: When an opposing Pokémon makes contact, it takes recoil damage equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP and has a 10% chance to be inflicted with Wrap.

undyingSoul.name: Undying Soul
undyingSoul.description: The user gains +1 to a random stat for each Normal-type or Fighting-type Pokémon in the party. When the user is knocked out, it revives one random Normal-type or Fighting-type Pokémon in the party. This effect can only be used once per battle.

unfazed.name: Unfazed
unfazed.description: Halves damage from super effective moves.

unitedJungle.name: United Jungle
unitedJungle.description: Heals 25% HP if replacing a fainted ally. Gains +10 Base Power to its moves for every fainted Grass-type Pokémon in the party.

unjustified.name: Unjustified
unjustified.description: Normal and Fighting-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! Halves damage from Fairy-type moves. Raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Fairy-type move.

unleashed.name: Unleashed
unleashed.description: Boosts the power of all moves when HP is low.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

unrealPressure.name: Unreal Pressure
unrealPressure.description: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokemon by 2. Lowers a random stat and Accuracy of the opponent by 1 stage when entering battle.

unseenFist.name: Unseen Fist
unseenFist.description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

unstoppablePoison.name: Unstoppable Poison
unstoppablePoison.description: Poison-type moves can hit Steel-types. Boosts Poison-type moves by 20%. 30% chance to badly poison the target.

unstoppableTitan.name: Unstoppable Titan
unstoppableTitan.description: The user's contact moves ignore type resistances and deal 1.2× damage. When dealing damage, hits are calculated against the target's lowest stat rather than Defense or Special Defense.

unyieldingCourage.name: Unyielding Courage
unyieldingCourage.description: Survives a hit that would knock it out when at full HP. Blocks one-hit KO moves. Has a 25% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out.

v8Engine.name: V8 Engine
v8Engine.description: Raises Speed by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

vacaySoul.name: Vacay Soul
vacaySoul.description: Triples the power of all moves. The Pokemon can only attack every other turn.

vesselOfRuin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vesselOfRuin.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

victoryStar.name: Victory Star
victoryStar.description: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

vileOvergrowth.name: Vile Overgrowth
vileOvergrowth.description: The user's Grass-type and Dark-type moves share type weakness advantages. Grass-type moves have a 30% chance to seed the target, and Dark-type moves have a 10% chance to inflict sleep.

vineFist.name: Vine Fist
vineFist.description: Boosts the power of punching moves by 30%. 30% chance to seed or bind the target when using punching moves.

virtualTacos.name: Virtual Tacos
virtualTacos.description: Restores 1/8 of max HP at the end of each turn.

vitalSpirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalSpirit.description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

voidBanishment.name: Void Banishment
voidBanishment.description: If the user switches in after a party member faints, upon entry it forces the target to switch Pokémon. If the target is Dark-type, it first takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP before the switch. Normal-type moves become Dark-type, deal 1.2× damage, and have a 20% chance to remove the target's held item.

volcanicCore.name: Volcanic Core
volcanicCore.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type and deal 1.2× damage. When the user uses a status move, it deals damage equal to 1/8 of the target's maximum HP.

voltAbsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltAbsorb.description: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move instead of taking damage.

voraciousVegetation.name: Voracious Vegetation
voraciousVegetation.description: Restores 1/8 of max HP when attacking certain types of Pokemon. Raises Attack and Speed by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

waaaa.name: Waaaa
waaaa.description: Has a 25% chance to land a critical hit. 10% chance to badly poison the target.

wakaFlockaFlame.name: Waka Flocka Flame
wakaFlockaFlame.description: Changes Normal-type moves to Fire-type and boosts their power by 20%. Flying and Fire-type moves share their type advantage against the same types! 10% chance to burn the target. Immune to Fire-type moves and heals HP when hit by Fire-type moves instead of taking damage.

wanderingSpirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wanderingSpirit.description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

waterAbsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterAbsorb.description: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move instead of taking damage.

waterBubble.name: Water Bubble
waterBubble.description: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

waterCompaction.name: Water Compaction
waterCompaction.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.

waterPowered.name: Water Powered
waterPowered.description: Changes non-Psychic and non-Ground-type moves to Water-type and boosts their power by 20%. Instead of taking damage from Water-type moves, raises a random stat by 1 stage.

waterVeil.name: Water Veil
waterVeil.description: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

weakArmor.name: Weak Armor
weakArmor.description: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.

wellBakedBody.name: Well-Baked Body
wellBakedBody.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

whirlwindAxe.name: Whirlwind Axe
whirlwindAxe.description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type. Flying-type moves have a 30% chance to force the target to switch out. If the target is forced out, the user restores 1/8 of its maximum HP.

whiteLightning.name: White Lightning
whiteLightning.description: The user's Normal-type moves become Electric-type and gain a 1.2× power boost. Dragon-type moves gain +1 critical-hit stage. Dragon-type and Electric-type moves have a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

whiteSmoke.name: White Smoke
whiteSmoke.description: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

wimpOut.name: Wimp Out
wimpOut.description: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

windPower.name: Wind Power
windPower.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

windRider.name: Wind Rider
windRider.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

windboltDiscard.name: Windbolt Discard
windboltDiscard.description: When the user uses a status move, it consumes a random held Berry and deals damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum HP.

windstormDiscard.name: Windstorm Discard
windstormDiscard.description: The user's attacks have a 30% chance to discard its own random held item. If it does, the attack deals 2.5× damage.

winnersGrin.name: Winner's Grin
winnersGrin.description: Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent. Raises a random stat by 1 stage after knocking out an opponent.

wonderGuard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderGuard.description: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

wonderSkin.name: Wonder Skin
wonderSkin.description: Makes status moves more likely to miss.

woodCutter.name: Wood Cutter
woodCutter.description: Boosts move power by 150% against Grass-type Pokemon. Raises Attack and Speed by 1 stage after knocking out a Grass-type Pokemon.

woodenLie.name: Wooden Lie
woodenLie.description: Doubles move power against certain types of Pokemon. Reduces damage from super effective moves by 25%.

yabaDabaDoo.name: Yaba Daba Doo
yabaDabaDoo.description: Raises all stats by 1 stage when entering battle. Lowers a random stat by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

yinYang.name: Yin Yang
yinYang.description: Ghost and Fairy-type moves share their type advantage against the same types!

zanySplasher.name: Zany Splasher
zanySplasher.description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type or Water-type depending on which type is stronger, chosen at random if they are equal. Fairy-type moves have a 5% chance to land a critical hit. Water-type moves have a 5% chance to inflict Whirlpool on the target. The user's evasion is raised by one stage when it enters battle.

zenMode.name: Zen Mode
zenMode.description: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is half or less.

zeroToHero.name: Zero to Hero
zeroToHero.description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

zombieColossus.name: Zombie Colossus
zombieColossus.description: Once per battle, when this Pokémon faints, it revives with 50% of its maximum HP.

zombieExperience.name: Zombie Experience
zombieExperience.description: Doubles move power against Dark, Ghost, and Ground-type Pokemon. Raises all stats by 1 stage after knocking out a Dark, Ghost, or Ground-type Pokemon.
